items.title: 美軍不是宣稱摧毀九成？伊朗地下工廠重啟飛彈生產
items.title_en: U.S. Not Claiming 90% Destruction? Iran’s Underground Factories Restart Missile Production
paras: 伊朗已利用戰前囤積的零組件，在地下設施恢復生產彈道飛彈，削弱美國與以色列宣稱已重創伊朗飛彈工業的戰果。美國及中東官員透露，德黑蘭目前雖只能以較低速度組裝飛彈，但可能仍有足夠零件生產數百枚武器，並正興建新的地下組裝據點，以躲避後續空襲。
《華爾街日報》(WSJ)周四(10日)援引知情官員消息報導，情報顯示伊朗多處地下設施重新出現生產活動，包括位於伊朗東南部的霍吉爾(Khojir)飛彈設施。伊朗正組裝液態燃料與固態燃料飛彈，前者須在發射前加注燃料，後者則可長時間儲存並隨時發射。

地下工廠恢復運作 美以戰果受到質疑

美國與以色列2月28日發動戰爭後，曾對伊朗飛彈生產基地、倉儲設施、飛彈及發射器進行數千次打擊，並破壞多座製造飛彈零件與成品所需的工業設施。美國海上封鎖也增加伊朗進口零件及固態燃料原料的難度。
不過，伊朗趁夏季戰事相對平靜期間修復軍事能力，並認為停火難以長久維持。一名美國官員表示，伊朗可能在6月中旬與川普簽署初步協議、同意開放荷姆茲海峽並展開結束戰爭談判後，便恢復低速生產。
白宮官員未直接回應伊朗是否重啟彈道飛彈生產，僅表示伊朗核設施已遭摧毀，軍事力量也受到嚴重削弱。美國國防部首席發言人帕內爾(Sean Parnell)則稱，美軍已摧毀伊朗最多90%的無人機、彈道飛彈及海軍工業基礎，並大幅削弱其發射飛彈與無人機的能力。
美國國防部長赫格塞斯(Pete Hegseth)4月也曾宣稱，伊朗飛彈計畫在功能上已被摧毀，既無國防工業，也沒有補充攻擊及防禦能力的手段。如今伊朗恢復組裝飛彈，顯示徹底瓦解其分散且深入地下的生產體系，遠比美方原先宣稱的更加困難。
美國飛彈防禦倡議聯盟(Missile Defense Advocacy Alliance)資深分析師Tal Inbar表示，只要轟炸一度停止，伊朗就能修復受損基礎設施，從其他國家取得新零件並存放於地下設施；若認為伊朗不會重建飛彈產能，未免過度天真。

零件庫存可組裝數百枚 消耗戰能力仍在

美國及區域官員表示，伊朗現階段主要使用既有零組件組裝新飛彈，產量仍低於戰前水準。倫敦國王學院訪問研究員、前美國中央情報局(CIA)伊朗軍事分析師Jim Lamson指出，伊朗戰前便囤積成品彈頭、飛彈彈體，以及導引與控制系統等零件。
過往由伊朗公布的影像顯示，大批飛彈零件整齊排列在地下設施牆邊。伊朗究竟能生產多少新飛彈，取決於零件庫存深度及仍可運作的地下設施數量。Lamson估計，可能是數百枚，也可能多達數千枚。
伊朗在戰爭期間消耗大量成品飛彈，迫使其降低攻擊規模，但整體能力尚未耗盡。Tal Inbar估計，伊朗目前的彈道飛彈庫存仍達數千枚。
伊朗持續對中東各地美軍基地發射飛彈，展示武器種類的多樣性，其中Kheibar Shekan飛彈具備機動性、精準度較高且製造成本相對低廉。伊朗周三對駐有美軍的約旦一處空軍基地發動大規模攻擊，影像顯示部分飛彈搭載集束彈頭，這類武器在戰爭初期也曾頻繁用於挑戰以色列防空系統。
伊朗飛彈產能恢復，也有助其繼續投入消耗戰，與美國及波斯灣國家逐漸縮減的飛彈攔截器庫存周旋。阿拉伯國家與以色列官員正為戰事延續及伊朗升高攻勢預作準備。伊朗近日並多次攻擊美國軍艦，雖未命中，但曾數度險些造成重大損失。

全面復產仍有障礙 但重建速度令人憂心

衛星影像顯示，伊朗正快速重建橋梁、道路及飛彈生產據點，也已重新打通遭美以空襲炸塌的飛彈基地隧道入口。以色列軍方研判，儲存在地下設施內的武器可能保存良好。
不過，伊朗若要全面恢復飛彈製造，仍面臨若干障礙，包括生產液態推進劑所需的化學設施受損，以及製造固態燃料所需的工業攪拌設備不足。美國封鎖也持續限制零件與原料輸入。
伊朗因缺乏現代化空軍，自1980年代兩伊戰爭期間便開始建立飛彈計畫，並逐漸將其視為嚇阻敵人的核心武力。2025年6月與以色列爆發12天戰爭後，伊朗也曾以快於預期的速度補充飛彈庫存，迫使以色列在同年底警告，可能有必要再次發動攻擊。
巴黎政治學院(Sciences Po)伊朗戰略專家Nicole Grajewski指出，飛彈生產能力比核計畫更容易恢復，而且相關設施高度分散。伊朗當初建立複雜且深入地下的飛彈基礎設施，正是為了在遭受攻擊後仍能保存並重建戰力。
paras_en: Iran has used pre‑war stockpiled components to resume ballistic missile production in underground facilities, undermining U.S. and Israeli claims of having crippled Iran’s missile industry. U.S. and Middle‑East officials say Tehran can currently assemble missiles at a slower pace but may still have enough parts to produce hundreds of weapons and is building new underground assembly sites to evade further air strikes.

The Wall Street Journal reported on Thursday (the 10th) that intelligence shows multiple Iranian underground sites have resumed production activity, including the Khojir missile facility in southeastern Iran. Iran is assembling both liquid‑fuel and solid‑fuel missiles; the former must be fueled before launch, while the latter can be stored for long periods and launched at any time.

The revival of underground factories calls U.S.‑Israeli war gains into question. After the February 28 war, the United States and Israel carried out thousands of strikes on Iranian missile production bases, storage sites, missiles and launchers, destroying many industrial facilities needed to make missile components and finished weapons. The U.S. naval blockade has also made it harder for Iran to import parts and solid‑fuel raw materials.

However, Iran used the relatively quiet summer period to repair its military capability and believes a cease‑fire cannot last long. A U.S. official said Iran could resume low‑rate production after a mid‑June preliminary agreement with Trump to reopen the Hormuz Strait and begin war‑ending talks.

White House officials did not directly answer whether Iran has restarted ballistic missile production, only noting that Iran’s nuclear facilities have been destroyed and its military strength severely weakened. Pentagon spokesperson Sean Parnell said the U.S. has destroyed up to 90% of Iran’s drones, ballistic missiles and naval industrial base, greatly reducing its ability to launch missiles and drones.

Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth also claimed in April that Iran’s missile program had been functionally destroyed, with no defense industry and no means to replenish offensive or defensive capabilities. Iran’s current missile assembly shows that fully dismantling its dispersed, deep‑underground production system is far harder than the U.S. originally claimed.

Tal Inbar, a senior analyst at the Missile Defense Advocacy Alliance, said that once bombing stops, Iran can repair damaged infrastructure, obtain new parts from abroad and store them underground; assuming Iran will not rebuild missile capacity would be overly naïve.

U.S. and regional officials say Iran is now mainly using existing stockpiled components to assemble new missiles, with output still below pre‑war levels. Jim Lamson, a researcher at King’s College London and former CIA Iran military analyst, noted that Iran had stockpiled complete warheads, missile bodies and guidance and control systems before the war.

Images released by Iran in the past show large numbers of missile parts neatly arranged along the walls of underground facilities. How many new missiles Iran can produce depends on the depth of its parts inventory and the number of underground sites still operational. Lamson estimates the figure could be in the hundreds, or possibly up to several thousand.

During the war Iran burned through a large stock of finished missiles, forcing it to scale back attacks, but its overall capability has not been exhausted. Tal Inbar estimates Iran still has several thousand ballistic missiles in its inventory.

Iran continues to fire missiles at U.S. bases across the Middle East, showcasing a variety of weapon types. The Kheibar Shekan missile is noted for its mobility, higher accuracy and relatively low cost. On Wednesday Iran launched a large‑scale attack on a U.S.‑occupied air base in Jordan, with footage showing some missiles carrying cluster munitions, a weapon used early in the war to challenge Israeli air defenses.

The revival of Iran’s missile capacity also helps it sustain a war of attrition against the United States and Gulf states, whose missile interceptor stocks are gradually dwindling. Arab and Israeli officials are preparing for a prolonged conflict and a heightened Iranian offensive. Iran has recently made several attacks on U.S. warships that missed but came close to causing serious damage.

Satellite imagery shows Iran rapidly rebuilding bridges, roads and missile production sites, and has reopened tunnel entrances to missile bases that were collapsed by U.S.–Israeli air strikes. Israeli military analysts assess that weapons stored in underground facilities may be in good condition.

Nevertheless, fully restoring missile production faces several hurdles, including damaged chemical plants needed for liquid‑propellant production and a shortage of industrial mixers required for solid‑fuel manufacturing. The U.S. blockade continues to limit the import of parts and raw materials.

Lacking a modern air force, Iran began its missile program in the 1980s during the Iran‑Iraq war and has increasingly treated missiles as its core deterrent force. After a 12‑day war with Israel in June 2025, Iran replenished its missile stock faster than expected, prompting Israel at the end of that year to warn that another attack might become necessary.

Nicole Grajewski, an Iran strategy expert at Sciences Po, said missile production capacity is easier to restore than a nuclear program and that related facilities are highly dispersed. Iran’s original strategy of building complex, deep‑underground missile infrastructure was intended to preserve and rebuild combat power after an attack.

items.title: AI下一個大商機來了？黃仁勳點名新戰場：網路安全
items.title_en: AI’s Next Big Business Opportunity? Jensen Huang Names New Battlefield: Cybersecurity
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)共同創辦人暨執行長黃仁勳(Jensen Huang)表示，網路安全可能成為人工智慧(AI)下一個主要應用市場。隨著AI自動生成程式碼的能力快速進步，軟體漏洞被利用及需要修補的速度同步加快，預料將顛覆現有網路安全產業。
黃仁勳周四(10日)在舊金山舉行的高盛(GS-US)科技會議上表示，「網路安全很可能是AI下一個重大應用領域」。他指出，AI模型使程式設計走向自動化，也讓安全漏洞出現、遭到攻擊及必須修復的速度大幅提升，企業對AI資安工具的需求將隨之增加。
談到AI既創造問題又催生市場需求時，黃仁勳說，還有什麼方式比創造問題更能製造需求？任何公司都希望市場急切需要自家產品，甚至排隊搶購，但業者可以選擇負責任的做法，也可能採取較不理想的方式。
黃仁勳此次面對投資人發言前，輝達上月才公布強勁的長期展望，進一步鞏固華爾街對AI資料中心支出將持續擴大的信心，並強化市場對輝達長期受惠的預期。不過，科技產業仍不斷被要求證明，投入AI基礎設施的龐大資本支出確實能創造經濟效益。
輝達持續進行投資與併購，也引發外界擔憂公司可能扭曲AI市場。輝達上周宣布，將以約130億美元收購AI新創Hugging Face，藉此把業務版圖從晶片進一步擴展至AI產業其他領域。
對於部分交易可能形成循環投資的質疑，黃仁勳予以否認。他表示，輝達投入少量資金後，最終能帶回更多收益，並稱市場開始意識到，輝達投資的領域通常也是值得投資的方向，因為公司掌握客戶真正需要滿足的基礎需求。
黃仁勳強調，輝達動用公司資金前，必須確認投資標的是一筆「穩賺的交易」。若一家潛在投資對象要符合這項標準，輝達必須先看到已有客戶準備採用其產品或服務，而不是僅憑市場題材承擔風險。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) co‑founder and CEO Jensen Huang said that cybersecurity could become the next major application market for artificial intelligence (AI). As AI’s ability to automatically generate code advances rapidly, the speed at which software vulnerabilities are exploited and need to be patched is accelerating, which is expected to disrupt the existing cybersecurity industry.

On Thursday (the 10th) at Goldman Sachs’ (GS-US) technology conference in San Francisco, Huang stated, “Cybersecurity is very likely to be AI’s next major application area.” He noted that AI models are automating software development and also dramatically increasing the speed at which security flaws appear, are attacked, and must be fixed, driving greater corporate demand for AI‑powered security tools.

When discussing how AI both creates problems and spawns market demand, Huang remarked that nothing creates demand faster than creating problems. Every company wants the market to urgently need its product, even to the point of queuing for purchases, but firms can choose a responsible approach or a less desirable one.

Before speaking to investors, NVIDIA had just released a strong long‑term outlook last month, further cementing Wall Street’s confidence that AI data‑center spending will continue to grow and reinforcing expectations that NVIDIA will benefit over the long run. However, the tech sector is still being asked to prove that the massive capital outlays for AI infrastructure truly generate economic returns.

NVIDIA’s ongoing investments and acquisitions have also raised concerns that the company could distort the AI market. Last week NVIDIA announced it would acquire AI startup Hugging Face for about $13 billion, extending its business beyond chips into other areas of the AI industry.

Addressing doubts that some deals might create a circular investment pattern, Huang denied the notion. He said that after NVIDIA puts in a modest amount of capital, it can ultimately bring back greater returns, and noted that the market is beginning to recognize that the areas NVIDIA invests in are usually worthwhile because the company understands the fundamental needs of its customers.

Huang emphasized that before deploying company funds, NVIDIA must confirm that an investment target is a “sure‑bet.” For a potential investment to meet this criterion, NVIDIA must first see existing customers ready to adopt the target’s products or services, rather than taking a risk based solely on market hype.

items.title: AI開始替人類探月！IBM、NASA聯手找冰層、挑登陸點
items.title_en: AI Begins Moon Exploration for Humanity! IBM and NASA Team Up to Locate Ice and Choose Landing Sites
paras: IBM(IBM-US)與美國航太總署(NASA)周四(10日)共同推出開源AI工具「NASA-IBM月球基礎模型」(NASA-IBM Lunar Foundation Model)，協助科學家分析數十年累積的月球觀測資料，並為人類長期進駐月球及未來火星任務提供支援。
這套模型利用NASA四項太空任務、九具觀測儀器蒐集的逾30層資料進行訓練，其中包括月球勘測軌道飛行器(Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter)取得的數據，目前已開放研究人員使用。
NASA-IBM月球基礎模型加入IBM與NASA共同開發的Prithvi開放式基礎模型系列，該系列應用範圍涵蓋地理空間、天氣及其他科學研究領域。
這套模型可協助研究人員辨識月球永久陰影區內可能存在的冰層、繪製隕石坑分布圖以選擇安全登陸地點，並分析月球表面的火山地形。這些工作過去通常需要科學家人工檢查大量地圖與影像，或仰賴解析度較低的機器學習工具。
NASA與IBM表示，在基準測試中，這套AI模型辨識月球表面重要特徵的準確度，最高比目前廣泛使用的方法提升23%，有望加快月球地質研究及登陸地點評估。
各國太空機構尤其重視月球冰層，因其代表可能存在可利用的水與氧氣。這些資源不僅是興建月球基地及維持太空人長期生活的關鍵，也可能用來製造火箭燃料，支援未來前往火星的任務。
NASA阿提米絲(Artemis)計畫預定2028年再次把太空人送上月球，測試建立人類長期駐留能力所需的新技術，並為後續火星探索任務奠定基礎。
paras_en: IBM (IBM-US) and NASA on Thursday (the 10th) jointly launched an open‑source AI tool called the “NASA‑IBM Lunar Foundation Model” to help scientists analyze decades of accumulated lunar observation data and to support humanity’s long‑term presence on the Moon as well as future Mars missions.

The model was trained on more than 30 layers of data gathered by NASA’s four space missions and nine instruments, including data obtained by the Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter, and it is now available for researchers to use.

The NASA‑IBM Lunar Foundation Model incorporates the Prithvi open‑foundation model series co‑developed by IBM and NASA, a series whose applications span geospatial, weather, and other scientific research domains.

The model can assist researchers in identifying possible ice deposits in permanently shadowed regions, mapping crater distributions to select safe landing sites, and analyzing volcanic terrain on the lunar surface. These tasks previously required scientists to manually examine large amounts of maps and images or rely on lower‑resolution machine‑learning tools.

NASA and IBM state that in benchmark tests the AI model’s accuracy in identifying important lunar surface features is up to 23% higher than the widely used methods currently, promising to accelerate lunar geological research and landing‑site evaluation.

Space agencies worldwide place particular emphasis on lunar ice because it may represent usable water and oxygen. These resources are not only key to building lunar bases and sustaining astronauts over the long term, but could also be used to produce rocket fuel to support future missions to Mars.

NASA’s Artemis program is scheduled to send astronauts back to the Moon in 2028, testing new technologies needed for sustained human presence and laying the groundwork for subsequent Mars exploration missions.

items.title: 美債殖利率狂飆 市場緊盯小型股是否成第一張骨牌
items.title_en: U.S. Treasury Yields Surge, Market Watches Whether Small Caps Are the First Domino
paras: 隨著小型股跌破關鍵技術價位，再度成為市場關注焦點，投資人正密切觀察全球債券殖利率攀升，是否會對股市帶來更大壓力。
市場普遍認為，小型股對利率變化較為敏感。因此，如果較高的借貸成本開始拖累小型股，可能是美國整體股市壓力升高的早期警訊。相較於大型企業，小型企業通常更依賴舉債支應營運，尤其是浮動利率債務。
羅素2000指數跌破50日均線
今年稍早表現大幅領先大型股後，小型股羅素2000指數近幾周開始陷入疲弱，標普500指數等其他主要指數則大致呈現橫盤整理。
根據 FactSet 資料，羅素2000指數涵蓋近2,000家規模最小的企業，成分股平均市值約19億美元；相較之下，標普500指數成分股平均市值約1,462億美元。
羅素2000指數周三再度走低，延續近期跌勢。FactSet 資料顯示，該指數上月底已跌破市場密切關注的50日移動平均線。由於50日均線通常被視為短期趨勢指標，跌破這項關鍵門檻可能意味後續仍有下跌空間。
自第三季開始以來，羅素2000指數已轉為下跌。根據道瓊市場數據，該指數目前可能寫下2025年初以來首次單季下跌。
油價與美債殖利率齊升 股市承壓
隨著原油價格與美國公債殖利率延續漲勢，美股周三持續承壓。芝商所（CME）FedWatch 工具顯示，聯邦基金期貨交易員預估，聯準會（Fed）下周升息的機率約為62%。
作為美國大型股主要指標的標普500指數周三同樣下跌，並逐漸逼近50日移動平均線。
羅素2000指數近期轉弱，可能加深部分投資人對整體市場的擔憂。在通膨持續僵固之際，Fed未來利率政策走向仍充滿不確定性。不過，市場仍有樂觀的理由，小型企業和大型企業一樣，都受惠於獲利強勁成長的預期。
專注投資中小型股的 Calamos Investments 資深投資組合經理 Brandon Nelson 表示，企業獲利強勁成長的跡象，是小型股今年稍早領先大盤的重要動力。
Nelson認為，近期回檔反而可能為年底前的強勁反彈創造更有利條件。
他在電話訪問中表示：「如果接下來幾周市場持續在目前水準震盪，我不會感到意外。我們正在為第四季可能出現的另一波漲勢打下基礎。」他並表示，自己對基本面仍相當樂觀。
近期歷史表現也對年底前的股市帶來正面訊號。根據道瓊市場數據，過去20年來，羅素2000指數在第四季的平均表現，優於標普500指數及另一項美國大型股指標羅素1000指數。若將時間拉長至1987年以來，這三項指數第四季平均漲幅則大致相近，且均呈現正報酬。
升息一碼未必引發市場恐慌
Nelson表示，第四季來臨前，股市仍面臨不少疑慮，包括伊朗衝突持續，以及交易員預期Fed可能考慮升息，以推動通膨回落至2%目標。
不過，他認為，即使Fed在9月升息，也不太可能代表新一輪積極升息循環的開始。央行若僅將政策利率調高1碼，幅度似乎不足以讓股市陷入恐慌。
Nelson表示：「我們目前並未採取防禦性布局。我認為，市場正蓄勢在第四季迎來一波大行情。」
paras_en: As small caps slip below a key technical level and regain market focus, investors are closely watching the rise in global bond yields to see if it will add further pressure on equities.

The market generally believes small caps are more sensitive to rate changes. Thus, if higher borrowing costs begin to weigh on small caps, it could be an early warning sign of rising pressure on the broader U.S. market. Compared with large firms, small companies usually rely more on debt to fund operations, especially floating‑rate debt.
Russell 2000 Index falls below its 50‑day moving average

After earlier outperformance of large‑cap stocks this year, the small‑cap Russell 2000 has been weakening over the past few weeks, while the S&P 500 and other major indices have largely been trading sideways.

According to FactSet, the Russell 2000 covers roughly 2,000 of the smallest companies, with an average market cap of about $1.9 billion; by contrast, the average market cap of S&P 500 constituents is about $146.2 billion.

The Russell 2000 slipped lower again on Wednesday, extending its recent decline. FactSet data show the index broke below the closely watched 50‑day moving average at the end of last month. Because the 50‑day line is often seen as a short‑term trend indicator, breaching this key threshold could signal further downside potential.
Since the start of the third quarter, the Russell 2000 has turned negative. Dow Jones market data suggest the index may be logging its first quarterly decline since early 2025.
Oil prices and U.S. Treasury yields rise together, weighing on stocks

With oil prices and U.S. Treasury yields continuing to climb, U.S. equities remained under pressure on Wednesday. CME’s FedWatch tool shows futures traders estimate a roughly 62% chance the Fed will raise rates next week.
The S&P 500, the main gauge for large‑cap U.S. stocks, also fell on Wednesday and is edging toward its 50‑day moving average.

The recent weakness in the Russell 2000 may deepen some investors’ concerns about the overall market. With inflation staying stubbornly high, the Fed’s future rate path remains uncertain. Nonetheless, there are optimistic reasons: both small and large firms stand to benefit from expectations of strong earnings growth.

Brandon Nelson, a senior portfolio manager at Calamos Investments who focuses on mid‑ and small‑cap stocks, said that signs of robust earnings growth were a key driver of small caps’ earlier outperformance versus the broader market.
Nelson believes the recent pullback could actually set up more favorable conditions for a strong rebound before year‑end.

He told reporters on a call, “If the market continues to oscillate around current levels over the next few weeks, I wouldn’t be surprised. We’re laying the groundwork for another rally in the fourth quarter.” He added that he remains quite optimistic on the fundamentals.

Recent historical performance also sends a positive signal for the market before year‑end. Dow Jones data show that over the past 20 years the Russell 2000’s average fourth‑quarter return has outperformed both the S&P 500 and the Russell 1000, another large‑cap benchmark. Extending the view back to 1987, the three indices have posted similar average gains in Q4 and all have delivered positive returns.
Rate hikes of a single basis point may not spark market panic

Nelson noted that ahead of the fourth quarter, the market still faces several concerns, including the ongoing Iran conflict and traders’ expectations that the Fed may consider a rate hike to bring inflation back down to its 2% target.

However, he argues that even if the Fed raises rates in September, it is unlikely to signal the start of a new aggressive tightening cycle. A one‑basis‑point increase in the policy rate would probably be too modest to frighten the market.
Nelson said, “We are not currently taking defensive positions. I think the market is building momentum for a big move in the fourth quarter.”

items.title: 美國上周初領失業金降至20.6萬人 企業裁員維持低檔
items.title_en: US Initial Unemployment Claims Fell to 206,000 Last Week, Corporate Layoffs Remain Low
paras: 美國上周初領失業金人數小幅下降，顯示企業裁員仍維持低檔，持續為勞動市場提供支撐。不過，續領失業金人數仍處於相對高檔，失業時間中位數也接近4年半高點，反映部分失業者重新找到工作的難度依然偏高。
美國勞工部周四(10日)公布，截至9月5日當周，經季節調整後的初領失業金人數減少1,000人至20.6萬人，略高於《路透》調查經濟學家預估的20.5萬人。
自7月中旬以來，初領失業金人數一直維持在18.9萬至21.2萬人的狹窄區間，顯示勞動市場在春末至夏季大部分時間一度放緩後，正逐漸重新站穩腳步。由於企業未出現大規模裁員，整體就業市場仍保持一定韌性。
美國政府上周公布，8月非農就業人口大增16.2萬人，創5個月來最大增幅，明顯高於7月增加的2.1萬人；失業率則維持在4.1%不變，顯示企業招聘活動有所回升。
不過，就業市場仍存在隱憂。8月失業時間中位數接近4年半高點，凸顯長期失業問題尚未改善。相較於企業裁員意願偏低，已經失去工作的人可能需要更長時間才能重新就業。
截至8月29日當周，至少連續兩周申領失業救濟的續領失業金人數減少1,000人，經季節調整後降至177.4萬人。這項數據常被視為衡量招聘情況的參考指標，其水準仍顯示企業在招募新員工方面保持謹慎。
paras_en: US initial unemployment claims slipped slightly last week, indicating that corporate layoffs are still at a low level and continue to support the labor market. However, the number of continuing claimants remains relatively high and the median duration of unemployment is near a four‑and‑a‑half‑year peak, reflecting that some job seekers still find it difficult to regain employment.

The US Labor Department announced on Thursday the 10th that, for the week ending September 5, seasonally adjusted initial unemployment claims fell by 1,000 to 206,000, a shade above the Reuters poll of economists that had forecast 205,000.

Since mid‑July, initial claims have stayed within a narrow band of 189,000 to 212,000, showing that after a slowdown from late spring through summer the labor market is gradually regaining footing. Because firms have not carried out large‑scale layoffs, the overall employment market retains a degree of resilience.

The US government reported last week that non‑farm payrolls surged by 162,000 in August, the biggest monthly gain in five months and far above the 21,000 increase in July; the unemployment rate held steady at 4.1%, indicating a pickup in hiring activity.

Nevertheless, the employment picture still harbors concerns. The median duration of unemployment in August hovered near the four‑and‑a‑half‑year high, underscoring that long‑term joblessness has not improved. While firms are reluctant to lay off workers, those who have already lost their jobs may face a longer road back to work.

For the week ending August 29, the number of people receiving continuing unemployment benefits for at least two consecutive weeks fell by 1,000 to a seasonally adjusted 1.774 million. This metric is often used as a gauge of hiring conditions, and its level still suggests that companies remain cautious in hiring new staff.

items.title: 川普精煉銅關稅踩煞車？白宮怕製造成本愈打愈高
items.title_en: Trump's Refined Copper Tariff Hits the Brakes? White House Fears Manufacturing Costs Could Rise Further
paras: 美國白宮尚未決定是否對精煉銅加徵關稅，知情人士透露，官員正權衡關稅推動國內採礦與冶煉的效益，以及銅價上漲推高製造成本的風險。在11月期中選舉逼近之際，川普政府日益重視民眾與企業的負擔能力，使銅關稅計畫陷入延宕。
《路透》周四(10日)引述兩名知情人士報導，白宮仍未對銅陰極、銅精礦等產品關稅作出最終決定。白宮官員證實，美國商務部已在6月30日期限前向總統川普提交最新評估，政府正持續研究各種方案，以促使銅及其他關鍵製造業回流美國。
川普與共和黨議員目前面臨壓力，必須證明經濟政策是在降低、而非推高美國消費者及企業成本。這項政治考量，也讓原本被市場視為幾乎勢在必行的精煉銅關稅增添變數。

搶在關稅前囤貨 美國銅庫存快速膨脹

市場先前普遍預期川普將擴大銅關稅，刺激銅價攀上歷史新高。交易商及工業買家為趕在新關稅上路前進口，爭相把銅運往美國，使當地形成全球規模最大的銅庫存之一。
政策遲遲未定，也讓囤積在美國的銅難以回流其他市場，進一步壓縮全球供應。Sprott資產管理礦業分析師Jacob White表示，只要關稅政策懸而未決，業者就缺乏將金屬重新運往國際市場的誘因。
銅廣泛用於建築、交通運輸、電子及其他工業領域。標普全球(SPGI-US)預估，AI及國防產業快速成長，將推動全球銅需求到2040年增加50%。
美國每年約有一半銅需求依靠進口，目前僅有兩座仍在運作的銅冶煉廠，分別由自由港麥克莫蘭(FCX-US)及力拓(RIO-US)擁有。美國地質調查所數據顯示，精煉銅進口量自2015年以來暴增至16倍，國內產量同期卻減少20%，儘管美國境內蘊藏的銅資源估計足以供應近30年。
支持者認為，提高進口銅成本有助改善美國採礦、冶煉及精煉計畫的經濟效益。力拓一名高層今年稍早便表示，現行銅相關政策及關稅，仍不足以抵銷公司在美國經營冶煉廠面臨的成本挑戰。

扶植本土產業恐推高物價 白宮陷入兩難

然而，擴大銅關稅也可能增加電氣設備、汽車、建材及其他工業產品製造商的原料成本，進而推升終端商品價格。如何在鼓勵國內生產、避免通膨升溫及維持川普降低生活成本的政治訴求之間取得平衡，已成為白宮的棘手難題。
市場對銅關稅的期待也重演2025年的情況。當時投資人原本預期川普將對所有含銅產品全面課稅，但他最終僅對管材、電線及其他半成品加徵關稅，並未把精煉銅納入，令銅礦商大失所望。
川普先前要求商務部長盧特尼克(Howard Lutnick)在6月底前更新銅市場評估，並就2027年1月1日起加徵15%關稅、2028年提高至30%的方案提出建議。目前尚不清楚盧特尼克向川普提出何種主張。
過去一年，川普積極推動美國銅礦開發，包括必和必拓(BHP-US)與力拓在亞利桑那州合作的Resolution Copper計畫，以及安托法加斯塔(Antofagasta)在明尼蘇達州的Twin Metals計畫。不過，在國內冶煉能力有限、製造業又高度依賴進口的現實下，銅關稅究竟能強化供應鏈，還是先推高企業與消費者成本，仍讓白宮難以拍板。
paras_en: The White House has not yet decided whether to impose tariffs on refined copper, insiders say, as officials weigh the benefits of tariffs for domestic mining and smelting against the risk that rising copper prices could increase manufacturing costs. With the November midterm elections approaching, the Trump administration is increasingly attentive to the affordability for consumers and businesses, causing the copper tariff plan to stall.

Reuters reported on Thursday (the 10th) that, according to two sources, the White House still has not made a final decision on tariffs for copper cathodes, copper concentrates and related products. White House officials confirmed that the Commerce Department submitted its latest assessment to President Trump before the June 30 deadline, and the administration continues to study various options to bring copper and other critical manufacturing back to the United States.

President Trump and Republican lawmakers are under pressure to demonstrate that economic policies are lowering, rather than raising, costs for American consumers and firms. This political consideration adds uncertainty to what the market had viewed as an almost inevitable refined copper tariff.

Rushing to stock up before tariffs, U.S. copper inventories swell rapidly. The market had broadly expected Trump to expand copper tariffs, pushing copper prices to historic highs. Traders and industrial buyers, eager to import before any new duties take effect, rushed copper into the United States, creating one of the world’s largest copper stockpiles domestically.

The policy delay also makes it difficult for copper accumulated in the United States to flow back to other markets, further tightening global supply. Sprott Asset Management mining analyst Jacob White said that as long as the tariff policy remains undecided, firms lack incentive to ship the metal back to international markets.

Copper is widely used in construction, transportation, electronics and other industrial sectors. S&P Global (SPGI-US) projects that rapid growth in AI and defense industries will drive global copper demand up 50% by 2040.

About half of U.S. copper demand is met by imports each year, and only two smelting plants remain operational, owned by Freeport-McMoRan (FCX-US) and Rio Tinto (RIO-US). U.S. Geological Survey data show that refined copper imports have surged 16‑fold since 2015, while domestic production has fallen 20% over the same period, even though estimated U.S. copper resources could supply the market for nearly 30 years.

Supporters argue that raising the cost of imported copper would improve the economics of U.S. mining, smelting and refining projects. A senior Rio Tinto executive said earlier this year that current copper policies and tariffs are still insufficient to offset the cost challenges the company faces operating a U.S. smelter.

Boosting domestic industry could raise prices, putting the White House in a bind. Expanding copper tariffs may increase raw material costs for manufacturers of electrical equipment, automobiles, building materials and other industrial products, potentially pushing up end‑product prices. Balancing encouragement of domestic production, avoiding inflationary pressure, and maintaining Trump’s political promise to lower living costs has become a thorny dilemma for the White House.

The market’s expectations for copper tariffs echo the 2025 episode. At that time investors expected Trump to levy duties on all copper‑containing products, but he ultimately imposed tariffs only on pipes, wires and other semi‑finished goods, leaving refined copper untaxed and disappointing miners.

Trump previously asked Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick to update the copper market assessment by the end of June and to propose a plan to impose a 15% tariff starting Jan. 1 2027, rising to 30% in 2028. It remains unclear what recommendations Lutnick presented to Trump.

Over the past year, Trump has actively promoted U.S. copper mining, including the Resolution Copper project by BHP (BHP-US) and Rio Tinto in Arizona, and Antofagasta’s Twin Metals project in Minnesota. However, with limited domestic smelting capacity and a manufacturing sector heavily reliant on imports, it remains uncertain whether copper tariffs will strengthen the supply chain or simply raise costs for businesses and consumers, leaving the White House unable to decide.

items.title: 法國欠央行的錢不用還？拉加德痛批極左派削債方案
items.title_en: France Doesn’t Have to Repay Money Owed to the Central Bank? Lagarde Slams Far‑Left Debt‑Wipeout Plan
paras: 歐洲中央銀行(ECB)總裁拉加德(Christine Lagarde)周四(10日)警告，法國極左派提出註銷央行持有政府債券、藉此削減龐大公共債務的構想，不僅在法律、技術及財務層面站不住腳，更可能危及法國的金融信譽。
法國總統候選人梅蘭雄(Jean-Luc Mélenchon)主張，註銷法國央行及ECB持有的法國政府債券，以降低政府的債務負擔。隨著法國將於明年春季舉行總統大選，這項提議已成為選前經濟政策辯論的焦點。
拉加德在柏林舉行的記者會上表示，一項政策不會因為不斷被重複，就能從法律、技術或財務上毫無道理，變成具有正當性的方案。
她以個人貸款為例指出，若有人拒絕償還現有貸款，之後卻又希望再次借款，最終不是必須支付高得多的融資成本，就是根本無法取得資金。她藉此警告，註銷政府債務可能破壞投資人信任，推升法國未來的借貸成本。
《彭博經濟》分析師Jean Dalbard與Bhargavi Sakthivel指出，即使排除法律、政治及經濟障礙，債務註銷看似能迅速減輕負擔，但政府取消實質上欠給自身體系的債務，未必能創造真正可運用的財政空間。
兩名分析師表示，金融市場也不太可能對此毫無反應。若法國在投資人心中的信用受損，公債殖利率與融資成本可能上升，最終反而使納稅人承擔更沉重的負擔。
這項主張先前已遭德國央行總裁納格爾(Joachim Nagel)公開反對，並在社群媒體引發激烈論戰，投資銀行家Matthieu Pigasse與國際貨幣基金(IMF)前首席經濟學家布蘭查德(Olivier Blanchard)也捲入討論。
拉加德引述布蘭查德的觀點指出，把債務從一個口袋挪到另一個口袋，並不代表債務真的消失。她最後直言，全面註銷央行持有的政府債務，是一項「財務上危險」的構想。
paras_en: European Central Bank (ECB) President Christine Lagarde warned on Thursday (the 10th) that the French far‑left’s proposal to write off government bonds held by the central bank – in order to slash the massive public debt – is untenable legally, technically and financially, and could jeopardise France’s financial credibility.

French presidential candidate Jean‑Luc Mélenchon argues for canceling French government bonds held by the Bank of France and the ECB to reduce the state’s debt burden. With a presidential election slated for next spring, the proposal has become a focal point of pre‑election economic policy debate.
Lagarde told a press conference in Berlin that a policy does not become legitimate simply because it is repeated, if it lacks legal, technical or financial justification.

She used personal loans as an example, noting that if someone refuses to repay an existing loan and then seeks a new one, they will either face much higher financing costs or be unable to obtain funds at all. She warned that writing off government debt could erode investor trust and push up France’s future borrowing costs.

Bloomberg Economics analysts Jean Dalbard and Bhargavi Sakthivel said that even if legal, political and economic hurdles were set aside, debt cancellation might appear to quickly ease the burden, but eliminating debt that the government owes to its own system does not necessarily create real fiscal space.

The two analysts added that financial markets are unlikely to remain unmoved. If France’s creditworthiness in investors’ eyes is damaged, bond yields and financing costs could rise, ultimately imposing a heavier burden on taxpayers.

The stance had previously been publicly opposed by German central bank president Joachim Nagel, sparking heated debate on social media, and drawing in investment banker Matthieu Pigasse and former IMF chief economist Olivier Blanchard into the discussion.

Lagarde quoted Blanchard’s view that moving debt from one pocket to another does not make the debt disappear. She concluded by calling a wholesale write‑off of central‑bank‑held government debt a "financially dangerous" idea.

items.title: 通膨壓不住、經濟又怕衰退！歐洲央行利率是否衝3% 分析師吵翻天
items.title_en: Inflation Unchecked, Economy Fears Recession! Will ECB Rates Hit 3%? Analysts Clash
paras: 歐洲中央銀行(ECB)周四(10日)如預期升息1碼(25個基點)，將存款利率調高至2.5%，為今年第二度升息，以因應美伊戰爭推升能源價格所帶來的通膨壓力。ECB雖未承諾後續行動，但分析師對本輪升息是否已近尾聲看法不一：部分認為年底前可能再度升息，另一些則警告，能源衝擊終將拖累成長，市場押注利率逼近3%可能過頭。
市場反應方面，歐元兌美元下跌0.3%至約1.159美元，歐元區公債殖利率升至多年高點，歐洲Stoxx 600指數下跌0.7%；油價則大漲逾4%至每桶105.3美元。

鷹派認為升息尚未結束 年底前可能再出手

德意志銀行(DB-US)首席歐洲經濟學家Mark Wall表示，通膨風險正在上升，ECB於12月再次升息的可能性或許已超過按兵不動。不過，ECB仍須謹慎行事，因歐元區經濟過去半年雖展現韌性，天然氣價格迅速上漲造成的負面供給衝擊正逐漸累積，最終勢必傷害成長，問題只在影響程度及何時浮現。
Saltmarsh Economics歐洲經濟學家Marchel Alexandrovich指出，ECB在三個月內第二度升息，並暗示未來幾次會議可能需要進一步緊縮。ECB雖未預先承諾升息，但最新預測顯示，2028年核心通膨仍達2.3%，高於6月預估的2.2%，意味若要讓通膨在中期回到2%目標，可能還需要繼續升息。
摩根大通私人銀行(JPMorgan Private Bank)(JPM-US)宏觀投資策略師Patrick Ernst認為，年底前再升息已不再只是低機率風險。中東衝突再次升級，推動油氣價格明顯上漲、美債遭到拋售，市場對主要央行繼續緊縮的預期也同步升高。
Ernst表示，ECB本次升息符合預期，但真正重要的是決策聲明仍為進一步緊縮保留空間，顯示能源引發的通膨風險依然存在，「這次升息並不是利率上限」，後續走向將高度取決於地緣政治局勢。
標普全球評級(S&P Global Ratings)(SPGI-US)歐洲、中東及非洲首席經濟學家Sylvain Broyer也表示，這次升息不只是預防性措施。歐洲通膨前景在夏季期間已經惡化，不僅供給衝擊增加，需求也愈來愈可能推升物價，因此ECB可能必須把利率調至具有限制性的水準，現階段不能排除繼續升息。

成長風險逐漸浮現 市場押注3%恐怕過頭

施羅德(Schroders)全球經濟主管David Rees則持較審慎看法。他指出，能源價格上漲將使整體通膨維持高檔，但核心通膨目前仍受控制，內需也正在轉弱；能源與融資成本同步上升，可能進一步壓抑歐元區經濟，2027年受到的衝擊尤其明顯。
Rees認為，儘管ECB聲明及經濟預測偏向鷹派，但再次升息的門檻仍高，本次行動更像本輪最後一次升息，而非長期升息周期的起點。除非經濟成長與通膨再次顯著加速，市場不應直接認定利率將朝3%邁進。
Quilter Cheviot固定收益研究主管Richard Carter表示，ECB面臨的平衡難題愈來愈棘手。歐元區部分地區成長仍然脆弱，決策官員必須在抑制通膨與避免進一步打擊經濟之間權衡。停滯性通膨雖尚未成為基本情境，但成長轉弱與通膨壓力重燃的組合，已愈來愈難以忽視。
Aviva Investors利率主管Ed Hutchings認為，ECB眼前首要任務確實是控制通膨，因此市場預期還會升息並非沒有道理。不過，在ECB已升息兩次、市場又反映超過兩次後續升息的情況下，投資人的緊縮押注可能已走得太遠。
富達國際(Fidelity International)歐元區經濟學家Conor Parle則提醒，天然氣及燃料價格上漲將促使ECB密切觀察物價壓力是否擴散。近期熱浪及供應鏈影響可能推高食品通膨，薪資追蹤指標也顯示薪資成長略微加速，決策官員將關注是否出現能源衝擊擴散至其他價格的早期跡象。
paras_en: The European Central Bank (ECB) on Thursday (the 10th) raised rates as expected by one quarter-point (25 basis points), lifting the deposit rate to 2.5%, marking its second hike this year to counter inflation pressure from higher energy prices driven by the US‑Iran war. The ECB did not pledge further action, and analysts are divided on whether this round of tightening is near its end: some think another hike could come before year‑end, while others warn that the energy shock will eventually drag down growth and that markets may be over‑betting on rates approaching 3%.

In market reaction, the euro fell 0.3% against the dollar to about $1.159, euro‑area sovereign yields rose to multi‑year highs, the European Stoxx 600 slipped 0.7%, and oil surged more than 4% to $105.3 a barrel.

Hawkish voices say the tightening is not over and another move may come before year‑end. Deutsche Bank (DB‑US) chief European economist Mark Wall said inflation risks are rising and the odds that the ECB will hike again in December may now exceed the odds of holding steady. Still, the ECB must act cautiously because, although the euro‑area economy has shown resilience over the past six months, the negative supply shock from rapidly rising natural‑gas prices is accumulating and will eventually hurt growth; the question is how severe and when it will materialise.

Saltmarsh Economics European economist Marchel Alexandrovich noted that the ECB’s second hike within three months hints that further tightening may be needed in upcoming meetings. While the ECB has not pre‑committed to more hikes, its latest forecasts show core inflation still at 2.3% in 2028, up from a June estimate of 2.2%, implying that bringing inflation back to the 2% target in the medium term may still require additional rate rises.

JPMorgan Private Bank (JPM‑US) macro investment strategist Patrick Ernst said a rate hike before year‑end is no longer a low‑probability risk. The renewed escalation of the Middle‑East conflict has pushed oil and gas prices sharply higher, U.S. Treasuries have been sold off, and market expectations for continued tightening by major central banks have risen in tandem.

Ernst added that the ECB’s move was in line with expectations, but the crucial point is that the policy statement still leaves room for further tightening, showing that inflation risks from energy remain. “This hike is not a ceiling on rates,” he said, and the path forward will depend heavily on geopolitical developments.

S&P Global Ratings (SPGI‑US) Europe, Middle East and Africa chief economist Sylvain Broyer also said the hike is more than a precautionary step. Europe’s inflation outlook worsened over the summer, with both supply shocks intensifying and demand increasingly likely to push prices up, so the ECB may have to lift rates to a restrictive level and cannot rule out further hikes at this stage.

Schroders global economics head David Rees took a more cautious view. He noted that higher energy prices will keep overall inflation elevated, but core inflation is still under control and domestic demand is weakening; the simultaneous rise in energy costs and financing costs could further suppress euro‑area growth, with the impact especially pronounced in 2027.

Rees argued that although the ECB’s statement and forecasts lean hawkish, the threshold for another hike remains high, and this move looks more like the last hike of the current cycle rather than the start of a prolonged tightening period. Unless growth and inflation accelerate markedly again, markets should not assume rates will march toward 3%.

Quilter Cheviot fixed‑income research head Richard Carter said the ECB’s balancing act is becoming increasingly tricky. Growth remains fragile in parts of the euro area, and policymakers must weigh curbing inflation against avoiding further damage to the economy. Stagnating inflation has not yet become a baseline scenario, but the combination of weakening growth and rekindling inflation pressures is becoming harder to ignore.

Aviva Investors rates head Ed Hutchings said the ECB’s immediate priority is indeed to rein in inflation, so market expectations of further hikes are not unfounded. However, after two hikes already and market pricing in more than two additional moves, investors’ tightening bets may have gone too far.

Fidelity International euro‑area economist Conor Parle warned that rising natural‑gas and fuel prices will make the ECB watch closely for any spread of price pressures. Recent heatwaves and supply‑chain issues could lift food inflation, and wage‑tracking indicators show a slight acceleration in pay growth, prompting policymakers to watch for early signs that the energy shock is spilling over into other price categories.

items.title: 亞資中心台南專區將簽MOU！金管會：地方自行招商 業務範圍尚未具體化
items.title_en: Asia Asset Management Center's Tainan Zone to Sign MOU! Financial Supervisory Commission: Local Governments Conduct Their Own Investment Promotion, Business Scope Not Yet Specified
paras: 亞資中心地方資產管理專區政策再開新戰場，繼高雄後，台南市政府也規劃推出資產管理專區並預計於下周簽署 MOU。外界關切專區定位、試辦業務範圍以及是否能與高雄劃分出「差異化特色」，金管會今(10)日表示，台南市現階段規劃屬於地方政府自行進行的招商活動，金管會尚未有具體的業務開放細節可對外說明。
金管會銀行局主秘周正山表示，金管會推動地方資產管理專區的基本立場，是樂見各縣市政府發揮自身特色與優勢、提供行政誘因來推動，不過，專區要成功，關鍵因素包含地方政策支持、金融業者積極投入資源、當地具備獨特的市場商機，以及金融法制相關配套條件等，幾項條件缺一不可。
媒體關注台南專區開放的金融業務是否會與高雄專區相同，抑或是會有專屬台南的「新亮點」？周正山指出，政策邏輯上當然希望各專區能依地方特色達成「差異化」，例如台南市目前祭出租金補貼等誘因招商，目前金管會尚未掌握具體的業務規劃訊息。
周正山進一步指出，下周的MOU簽署屬於台南市政府自身的招商過程與商業行為，非金管會主導的政策時程。他強調，流程上仍須由地方政府提出具體規劃並進行招商，待金融業者提出明確的資源投入計畫後，主管機關才會進一步檢視法規法制面需要何種配合調整，並給予相關協助。
至於台南專區未來是否有可能開放不同於高雄的全新試辦項目？周正山僅表示，若未來台南專區要推動業務，原則上仍會透過「試辦機制」來進行。金管會理解地方政府極具企圖心與意願，後續會持續與台南市政府保持聯繫溝通，惟現階段金管會立場尚無法給予過多具體的結論，一切仍有待地方政府與業者提出更明確的具體規劃後，才能進一步協助推動。
paras_en: The Asia Asset Management Center’s local asset‑management zone policy is opening a new front. After Kaohsiung, the Tainan municipal government is also planning to launch an asset‑management zone and expects to sign an MOU next week. Observers are concerned about the zone’s positioning, the scope of pilot services, and whether it can differentiate itself from Kaohsiung. The Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) said on the 10th that Tainan’s current plan is a locally driven investment‑promotion activity, and the FSC has no concrete details on the business opening to disclose publicly.

FSC Banking Bureau Secretary‑General Zhou Zhengshan said the FSC’s basic stance on promoting local asset‑management zones is to welcome each county or city to leverage its own characteristics and advantages and provide administrative incentives. However, for a zone to succeed, key factors include local policy support, active resource commitment from financial firms, unique market opportunities in the area, and appropriate financial‑law regulatory frameworks—none of which can be missing.

Media have asked whether the financial services open to Tainan’s zone will be the same as those in Kaohsiung or whether there will be Tainan‑specific “new highlights.” Zhou explained that, in principle, the policy logic hopes each zone can achieve differentiation based on local traits—for example, Tainan is currently offering rent‑subsidy incentives to attract investment—but the FSC has not yet obtained concrete information on the planned services.

Zhou further noted that next week’s MOU signing is part of Tainan city’s own investment‑promotion process and commercial activity, not a policy timeline led by the FSC. He emphasized that the local government must first present a detailed plan and conduct the promotion; once financial firms submit clear resource‑investment proposals, the regulator will then review what regulatory adjustments are needed and provide relevant assistance.

As for whether Tainan’s zone might eventually open pilot projects that differ from Kaohsiung’s, Zhou said that any future business rollout would generally follow a “pilot‑testing mechanism.” The FSC acknowledges the local government’s strong ambition and willingness, and will continue to stay in contact with Tainan officials. However, at this stage the FSC cannot give many concrete conclusions; further assistance will depend on the local government and firms presenting clearer, more specific plans.

富邦投信表示，此次分割主要透過降低每單位交易價格，提升投資人參與便利性；惟分割僅改變受益權單位數及每單位淨值，投資人持有基金的總資產價值不因分割而改變。投資人應特別留意11月11日至16日暫停交易期間，提前做好資金與交易安排，並以富邦投信及證交所最新公告為準。
富邦NASDAQ ETF 經理人王辰方表示，00662成立於2016年6月3日，為國內具高知名度海外科技型ETF，此次分割後交易價格降低，可望讓投資人更容易依自身資金規模進行配置，並有利定期定額或分批布局。
展望美股，AI仍是支撐科技產業中長期成長的重要主軸。王辰方指出，美國企業AI支出持續擴張，今年上半年美股行情主要由企業獲利預估上修驅動，儘管大型科技企業積極提高AI資本支出，短期可能牽動市場對估值的看法，但目前企業獲利與利潤率仍維持強勁，科技企業資本支出占營收比重亦處高檔，顯示AI基礎建設投資週期尚未出現明顯降溫。
此外，NASDAQ-100高度聚焦科技及創新產業，截至2026年8月底，資訊科技產業占比約66.36%，前十大成分股合計權重45.79%，涵蓋AI晶片、雲端運算、軟體、電商及數位平台等科技龍頭。王辰方表示，AI投資已逐步由算力建置向應用與商業化延伸，中長期科技產業成長趨勢仍值得關注；投資人可透過00662參與NASDAQ-100大型科技企業成長機會，並採分批或定期定額方式布局。

paras_en: Fubon NASDAQ ETF (00662‑TW), which tracks the NASDAQ‑100 index, is about to undergo a split. Fubon Asset Management said the split ratio for the ETF’s units will be 5‑for‑1, i.e., a 1‑for‑5 split. The fund will suspend primary‑market subscriptions/redemptions, secondary‑market trading and conversions from Nov 11 to Nov 16, and will resume trading, subscriptions/redemptions, securities lending and clearing on Nov 17, when the new units will also begin trading.

Fubon Asset Management explained that the split is intended to lower the per‑unit price and make participation easier for investors. The split only changes the number of units and the net asset value per unit; the total value of investors’ holdings remains unchanged. Investors should note the trading halt from Nov 11‑16, plan their cash and transaction needs in advance, and follow the latest announcements from Fubon and the Taiwan Stock Exchange.

ETF manager Wang Chen‑fang said the 00662 fund, launched on June 3, 2016, is a well‑known domestic ETF that provides exposure to overseas technology stocks. After the split, the lower trading price should make it easier for investors to allocate according to their capital size and is conducive to systematic‑investment or staggered buying strategies.

Looking ahead to U.S. equities, AI remains a key driver of medium‑ to long‑term growth in the tech sector. Wang noted that U.S. companies continue to expand AI spending; the first half of this year’s market rally was mainly driven by upward revisions to corporate earnings forecasts. Although large tech firms are boosting AI capital expenditures, which could temporarily affect valuation sentiment, corporate earnings and profit margins remain strong, and tech capex as a share of revenue stays at a high level, indicating that the AI infrastructure investment cycle has not cooled markedly.

Moreover, the NASDAQ‑100 is heavily weighted toward technology and innovation. As of the end of August 2026, the information‑technology sector accounted for about 66.36% of the index, and the top ten constituents together made up 45.79%, covering AI chips, cloud computing, software, e‑commerce and digital platforms. Wang said AI investment is shifting from building compute power to applications and commercialization, and the medium‑ to long‑term growth trend of the tech industry remains worth watching. Investors can use 00662 to tap the growth of large NASDAQ‑100 tech firms and consider staggered or systematic‑investment approaches.

items.title: 永捷8月、前8月營收雙創歷年新高  受惠業外貢獻、運動品牌旺季添動能
items.title_en: Yongjie Posts Record High Revenue for August and First Eight Months, Boosted by Non-Operating Gains and Sports‑Brand Seasonal Demand
paras: 永捷(4714-TW)今(10)日公告8月營收1.91億元、月增28.43％、年增42.95%，累計今(2026)年前8月合併營收達15.26億元，較去年同期大幅成長62.81％，雙雙同步刷新歷年同期新高紀錄。

永捷表示，8月及累計前8月營收雙雙創下歷年同期新高，主要受惠國際運動品牌因應年底銷售旺季，相繼推出新品上市計畫，帶動高機能與環保鞋材訂單出貨增加，推升整體產能稼動率維持一定水準，加上今年以來「荷久暻」建案交屋持續認列，8月「湖美帝璟」建案亦如期交屋貢獻，挹注整體營運維持良好成長動能，另為搶攻全球環保永續材料商機，永捷正加速完成麻豆廠公共危險物品倉庫建置，可提高化學原物料安全備貨量，有利提升歐洲環保產品訂單承接能力。
同時，永捷廠內亦已啟動反應槽建置工程，規劃於明(2027)年第3季投入生產，以配合海外新客戶訂單需求。永捷指出，新增設備將有助提升生產效率、擴充聚酯多元醇產能，並支應日本、印度等海外市場後續訂單，進一步擴大整體業務接單規模。
展望2026年下半年，永捷維持審慎樂觀看法，目前國際運動品牌庫存已逐步回到健康水位，既有鞋款補庫存、新鞋款開發及環保材料導入同步推進，歐洲水性PU、高固含量及無溶劑產品亦持續放量，有助於提升產能利用率及高附加價值產品比重，公司將以四大核心發展主軸，強化環保、高機能鞋材與電子材料等多元應用布局，以期創造未來營運良好成長動能。
paras_en: Yongjie (4714‑TW) announced on the 10th that August revenue reached NT$1.91 billion, up 28.43% month‑over‑month and 42.95% year‑over‑year, and that cumulative consolidated revenue for the first eight months of 2026 hit NT$15.26 billion, a 62.81% increase from the same period last year, both setting new historical highs for the comparable periods.

The company said the record‑setting August and year‑to‑date revenues were mainly driven by international sports brands launching new‑product plans for the year‑end sales peak, which lifted orders for high‑performance and eco‑friendly shoe materials and kept overall capacity utilization at a solid level. In addition, the continued hand‑over of the “He Jiu‑Jing” project and the on‑schedule delivery of the “Hu Mei Di‑Jing” project in August have injected further growth momentum, while Yongjie is accelerating the construction of a public‑dangerous‑goods warehouse at its Madou plant to increase safe stock of chemical raw materials and enhance its ability to serve European eco‑product orders.

The firm also reported that a reactor‑tank construction project inside the plant has been launched, with production slated to start in the third quarter of 2027 to meet new overseas customer orders. The added equipment is expected to improve production efficiency, expand polyester polyol capacity, and support follow‑on orders from markets such as Japan and India, further enlarging the overall order intake scale.

Looking ahead to the second half of 2026, Yongjie maintains a cautiously optimistic outlook. International sports‑brand inventories are returning to healthy levels, with existing shoe models restocked, new models developed, and eco‑material integration progressing in tandem. European water‑based PU, high‑solid‑content and solvent‑free products continue to scale up, boosting capacity utilization and the share of high‑value‑added products. The company will focus on four core development pillars to strengthen its diversified applications in eco‑friendly, high‑performance shoe materials and electronic materials, aiming to generate strong future growth momentum.

items.title: 汽燃費開徵助攻！電支7月代收付衝上330億元 街口竄升至第二
items.title_en: Fuel Tax Collection Boosts Growth! E‑payments Reach NT$33.01 billion in July, JKoPay Jumps to Second Place
paras: 金管會今(10)日公布最新電子支付業務概況，截至2026年7月底，國內電子支付帳戶總使用者人數已突破4,151萬人，月增38萬人；在交易表現上，7月「代理收付實質交易款項金額」達到330.1億元，較上月大幅增加33.6億元。金管會指出，電支代收付金額顯著成長，主要受惠於7月開徵的公路養護費(汽燃費)繳費需求帶動。其中，連加電支以 112 億元穩居霸主，街口支付以63億元竄升至第二名。
統計顯示，截至7月底，全台共有10家專營及19家兼營電子支付機構(含銀行及中華郵政)，華南銀行因無實際兼營電子支付業務需求，今年第一季底已依法完成許可註銷。在核心業務指標中，7月當月辦理國內外小額匯兌金額約180.1億元，月增7.4億元；當月收受儲值款項金額達335億元，月增15億元；支付款項餘額也提升至200.9億元。
銀行局主任秘書周正山表示，7月代理收付金額大幅衝高，繳納汽燃費是主要推手之一。其中，一卡通(iPASS MONEY)受惠於繳費效益，單月代收付金額顯著成長5.4億元；街口支付增加8.8億元；玉山銀行亦成長3.9億元，顯示電支業者積極拓展公共事業繳費場景已見成效。
觀察專營電子支付業者的個別表現，連加電支(LINE Pay Money)以單月 112.3 億元穩居市場第一，月增近 9%；街口支付以 63.02 億元攀升至第二名，月增幅達 16.27%；全支付則以 60.84 億元位居第三。值得注意的是，一卡通7月代收付金額達 23.73 億元，月增率近 3 成，成長力道極為強勁。
使用者人數方面，街口支付以 733.6 萬人持續霸榜第一；全支付以 727.5 萬人緊追在後；一卡通則以 725.4 萬人位居第三。此外，連加電支展現驚人吸客力，單月用戶淨增近 15 萬人、總用戶數達 436.7 萬人，為全市場用戶成長最顯著的業者。
此外，在儲值卡部分，7月總流通卡數已達2.34億張，當月消費卡數約1,340萬張，當月消費金額約62.9億元，儲值總餘額升至160.8億元，各項數據均呈現穩定微幅上升趨勢，顯示電支與儲值卡雙軌並進，持續深入國人日常支付生活。
paras_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission announced today (Oct 10) the latest overview of electronic payment services. As of the end of July 2026, the total number of domestic electronic payment account users has surpassed 41.51 million, an increase of 380,000 month‑over‑month. In terms of transaction performance, July’s “actual transaction amount for agency collection and payment” reached NT$33.01 billion, up NT$3.36 billion from the previous month. The FSC noted that the sharp rise in e‑payment collection amounts was mainly driven by the newly imposed highway maintenance (fuel tax) payments in July. Among them, LINE Pay Money remained the leader with NT$11.2 billion, while JKoPay surged to second place with NT$6.3 billion.

Statistics show that by the end of July, Taiwan had 10 dedicated and 19 joint electronic payment institutions (including banks and Chunghwa Post). Hua Nan Bank, having no actual need to operate joint electronic payment services, completed the legal cancellation of its license at the end of Q1 this year. In core business metrics, July saw domestic and overseas small‑amount foreign exchange transactions of about NT$18.01 billion, up NT$740 million month‑over‑month; the amount of stored‑value funds received reached NT$33.5 billion, up NT$1.5 billion; and the balance of payment funds rose to NT$20.09 billion.

Deputy Secretary‑General of the Banking Bureau Zhou Zhengshan said that the sharp jump in agency collection amounts in July was largely driven by fuel tax payments. The iPASS MONEY card benefited from the payment incentive, with its monthly agency collection amount growing by NT$540 million; JKoPay added NT$880 million; and E‑Sun Bank grew by NT$390 million, showing that e‑payment providers’ active expansion into public‑utility payment scenarios is bearing fruit.

Looking at the performance of dedicated e‑payment providers, LINE Pay Money held the market lead with NT$11.23 billion for the month, up nearly 9% month‑over‑month. JKoPay climbed to second place with NT$6.302 billion, a month‑over‑month increase of 16.27%. AllPay ranked third with NT$6.084 billion. Notably, iPASS MONEY’s agency collection amount reached NT$2.373 billion in July, a month‑over‑month growth rate of almost 30%, indicating very strong momentum.

In terms of user numbers, JKoPay continued to top the chart with 7.336 million users; AllPay followed closely with 7.275 million; and iPASS ranked third with 7.254 million. Meanwhile, LINE Pay Money demonstrated remarkable customer acquisition, adding nearly 150,000 net new users in the month for a total of 4.367 million users, making it the fastest‑growing provider in the market.

In the stored‑value card segment, the total number of circulating cards reached 234 million in July, with about 13.4 million cards used for transactions that month and transaction volume of approximately NT$6.29 billion. The total stored‑value balance rose to NT$16.08 billion. All figures showed a stable, modest upward trend, indicating that e‑payments and stored‑value cards are advancing on parallel tracks and becoming increasingly embedded in everyday payment life in Taiwan.

items.title: AI下一個大商機來了？黃仁勳點名新戰場：網路安全
items.title_en: AI’s Next Big Business Opportunity? Jensen Huang Names New Battlefield: Cybersecurity
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)共同創辦人暨執行長黃仁勳(Jensen Huang)表示，網路安全可能成為人工智慧(AI)下一個主要應用市場。隨著AI自動生成程式碼的能力快速進步，軟體漏洞被利用及需要修補的速度同步加快，預料將顛覆現有網路安全產業。
黃仁勳周四(10日)在舊金山舉行的高盛(GS-US)科技會議上表示，「網路安全很可能是AI下一個重大應用領域」。他指出，AI模型使程式設計走向自動化，也讓安全漏洞出現、遭到攻擊及必須修復的速度大幅提升，企業對AI資安工具的需求將隨之增加。
談到AI既創造問題又催生市場需求時，黃仁勳說，還有什麼方式比創造問題更能製造需求？任何公司都希望市場急切需要自家產品，甚至排隊搶購，但業者可以選擇負責任的做法，也可能採取較不理想的方式。
黃仁勳此次面對投資人發言前，輝達上月才公布強勁的長期展望，進一步鞏固華爾街對AI資料中心支出將持續擴大的信心，並強化市場對輝達長期受惠的預期。不過，科技產業仍不斷被要求證明，投入AI基礎設施的龐大資本支出確實能創造經濟效益。
輝達持續進行投資與併購，也引發外界擔憂公司可能扭曲AI市場。輝達上周宣布，將以約130億美元收購AI新創Hugging Face，藉此把業務版圖從晶片進一步擴展至AI產業其他領域。
對於部分交易可能形成循環投資的質疑，黃仁勳予以否認。他表示，輝達投入少量資金後，最終能帶回更多收益，並稱市場開始意識到，輝達投資的領域通常也是值得投資的方向，因為公司掌握客戶真正需要滿足的基礎需求。
黃仁勳強調，輝達動用公司資金前，必須確認投資標的是一筆「穩賺的交易」。若一家潛在投資對象要符合這項標準，輝達必須先看到已有客戶準備採用其產品或服務，而不是僅憑市場題材承擔風險。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) co‑founder and CEO Jensen Huang said that cybersecurity could become the next major application market for artificial intelligence (AI). As AI’s ability to automatically generate code advances rapidly, the speed at which software vulnerabilities are exploited and need to be patched is accelerating, which is expected to disrupt the existing cybersecurity industry.

On Thursday (the 10th) at Goldman Sachs’ (GS-US) technology conference in San Francisco, Huang stated, “Cybersecurity is very likely to be AI’s next major application area.” He noted that AI models are automating software development and also dramatically increasing the speed at which security flaws appear, are attacked, and must be fixed, driving greater corporate demand for AI‑powered security tools.

When discussing how AI both creates problems and spawns market demand, Huang remarked that nothing creates demand faster than creating problems. Every company wants the market to urgently need its product, even to the point of queuing for purchases, but firms can choose a responsible approach or a less desirable one.

Before speaking to investors, NVIDIA had just released a strong long‑term outlook last month, further cementing Wall Street’s confidence that AI data‑center spending will continue to grow and reinforcing expectations that NVIDIA will benefit over the long run. However, the tech sector is still being asked to prove that the massive capital outlays for AI infrastructure truly generate economic returns.

NVIDIA’s ongoing investments and acquisitions have also raised concerns that the company could distort the AI market. Last week NVIDIA announced it would acquire AI startup Hugging Face for about $13 billion, extending its business beyond chips into other areas of the AI industry.

Addressing doubts that some deals might create a circular investment pattern, Huang denied the notion. He said that after NVIDIA puts in a modest amount of capital, it can ultimately bring back greater returns, and noted that the market is beginning to recognize that the areas NVIDIA invests in are usually worthwhile because the company understands the fundamental needs of its customers.

Huang emphasized that before deploying company funds, NVIDIA must confirm that an investment target is a “sure‑bet.” For a potential investment to meet this criterion, NVIDIA must first see existing customers ready to adopt the target’s products or services, rather than taking a risk based solely on market hype.

items.title: 美債殖利率狂飆 市場緊盯小型股是否成第一張骨牌
items.title_en: U.S. Treasury Yields Surge, Market Watches Whether Small Caps Are the First Domino
paras: 隨著小型股跌破關鍵技術價位，再度成為市場關注焦點，投資人正密切觀察全球債券殖利率攀升，是否會對股市帶來更大壓力。
市場普遍認為，小型股對利率變化較為敏感。因此，如果較高的借貸成本開始拖累小型股，可能是美國整體股市壓力升高的早期警訊。相較於大型企業，小型企業通常更依賴舉債支應營運，尤其是浮動利率債務。
羅素2000指數跌破50日均線
今年稍早表現大幅領先大型股後，小型股羅素2000指數近幾周開始陷入疲弱，標普500指數等其他主要指數則大致呈現橫盤整理。
根據 FactSet 資料，羅素2000指數涵蓋近2,000家規模最小的企業，成分股平均市值約19億美元；相較之下，標普500指數成分股平均市值約1,462億美元。
羅素2000指數周三再度走低，延續近期跌勢。FactSet 資料顯示，該指數上月底已跌破市場密切關注的50日移動平均線。由於50日均線通常被視為短期趨勢指標，跌破這項關鍵門檻可能意味後續仍有下跌空間。
自第三季開始以來，羅素2000指數已轉為下跌。根據道瓊市場數據，該指數目前可能寫下2025年初以來首次單季下跌。
油價與美債殖利率齊升 股市承壓
隨著原油價格與美國公債殖利率延續漲勢，美股周三持續承壓。芝商所（CME）FedWatch 工具顯示，聯邦基金期貨交易員預估，聯準會（Fed）下周升息的機率約為62%。
作為美國大型股主要指標的標普500指數周三同樣下跌，並逐漸逼近50日移動平均線。
羅素2000指數近期轉弱，可能加深部分投資人對整體市場的擔憂。在通膨持續僵固之際，Fed未來利率政策走向仍充滿不確定性。不過，市場仍有樂觀的理由，小型企業和大型企業一樣，都受惠於獲利強勁成長的預期。
專注投資中小型股的 Calamos Investments 資深投資組合經理 Brandon Nelson 表示，企業獲利強勁成長的跡象，是小型股今年稍早領先大盤的重要動力。
Nelson認為，近期回檔反而可能為年底前的強勁反彈創造更有利條件。
他在電話訪問中表示：「如果接下來幾周市場持續在目前水準震盪，我不會感到意外。我們正在為第四季可能出現的另一波漲勢打下基礎。」他並表示，自己對基本面仍相當樂觀。
近期歷史表現也對年底前的股市帶來正面訊號。根據道瓊市場數據，過去20年來，羅素2000指數在第四季的平均表現，優於標普500指數及另一項美國大型股指標羅素1000指數。若將時間拉長至1987年以來，這三項指數第四季平均漲幅則大致相近，且均呈現正報酬。
升息一碼未必引發市場恐慌
Nelson表示，第四季來臨前，股市仍面臨不少疑慮，包括伊朗衝突持續，以及交易員預期Fed可能考慮升息，以推動通膨回落至2%目標。
不過，他認為，即使Fed在9月升息，也不太可能代表新一輪積極升息循環的開始。央行若僅將政策利率調高1碼，幅度似乎不足以讓股市陷入恐慌。
Nelson表示：「我們目前並未採取防禦性布局。我認為，市場正蓄勢在第四季迎來一波大行情。」
paras_en: As small caps slip below a key technical level and regain market focus, investors are closely watching the rise in global bond yields to see if it will add further pressure on equities.

The market generally believes small caps are more sensitive to rate changes. Thus, if higher borrowing costs begin to weigh on small caps, it could be an early warning sign of rising pressure on the broader U.S. market. Compared with large firms, small companies usually rely more on debt to fund operations, especially floating‑rate debt.
Russell 2000 Index falls below its 50‑day moving average

After earlier outperformance of large‑cap stocks this year, the small‑cap Russell 2000 has been weakening over the past few weeks, while the S&P 500 and other major indices have largely been trading sideways.

According to FactSet, the Russell 2000 covers roughly 2,000 of the smallest companies, with an average market cap of about $1.9 billion; by contrast, the average market cap of S&P 500 constituents is about $146.2 billion.

The Russell 2000 slipped lower again on Wednesday, extending its recent decline. FactSet data show the index broke below the closely watched 50‑day moving average at the end of last month. Because the 50‑day line is often seen as a short‑term trend indicator, breaching this key threshold could signal further downside potential.
Since the start of the third quarter, the Russell 2000 has turned negative. Dow Jones market data suggest the index may be logging its first quarterly decline since early 2025.
Oil prices and U.S. Treasury yields rise together, weighing on stocks

With oil prices and U.S. Treasury yields continuing to climb, U.S. equities remained under pressure on Wednesday. CME’s FedWatch tool shows futures traders estimate a roughly 62% chance the Fed will raise rates next week.
The S&P 500, the main gauge for large‑cap U.S. stocks, also fell on Wednesday and is edging toward its 50‑day moving average.

The recent weakness in the Russell 2000 may deepen some investors’ concerns about the overall market. With inflation staying stubbornly high, the Fed’s future rate path remains uncertain. Nonetheless, there are optimistic reasons: both small and large firms stand to benefit from expectations of strong earnings growth.

Brandon Nelson, a senior portfolio manager at Calamos Investments who focuses on mid‑ and small‑cap stocks, said that signs of robust earnings growth were a key driver of small caps’ earlier outperformance versus the broader market.
Nelson believes the recent pullback could actually set up more favorable conditions for a strong rebound before year‑end.

He told reporters on a call, “If the market continues to oscillate around current levels over the next few weeks, I wouldn’t be surprised. We’re laying the groundwork for another rally in the fourth quarter.” He added that he remains quite optimistic on the fundamentals.

Recent historical performance also sends a positive signal for the market before year‑end. Dow Jones data show that over the past 20 years the Russell 2000’s average fourth‑quarter return has outperformed both the S&P 500 and the Russell 1000, another large‑cap benchmark. Extending the view back to 1987, the three indices have posted similar average gains in Q4 and all have delivered positive returns.
Rate hikes of a single basis point may not spark market panic

Nelson noted that ahead of the fourth quarter, the market still faces several concerns, including the ongoing Iran conflict and traders’ expectations that the Fed may consider a rate hike to bring inflation back down to its 2% target.

However, he argues that even if the Fed raises rates in September, it is unlikely to signal the start of a new aggressive tightening cycle. A one‑basis‑point increase in the policy rate would probably be too modest to frighten the market.
Nelson said, “We are not currently taking defensive positions. I think the market is building momentum for a big move in the fourth quarter.”

items.title: 美國上周初領失業金降至20.6萬人 企業裁員維持低檔
items.title_en: US Initial Unemployment Claims Fell to 206,000 Last Week, Corporate Layoffs Remain Low
paras: 美國上周初領失業金人數小幅下降，顯示企業裁員仍維持低檔，持續為勞動市場提供支撐。不過，續領失業金人數仍處於相對高檔，失業時間中位數也接近4年半高點，反映部分失業者重新找到工作的難度依然偏高。
美國勞工部周四(10日)公布，截至9月5日當周，經季節調整後的初領失業金人數減少1,000人至20.6萬人，略高於《路透》調查經濟學家預估的20.5萬人。
自7月中旬以來，初領失業金人數一直維持在18.9萬至21.2萬人的狹窄區間，顯示勞動市場在春末至夏季大部分時間一度放緩後，正逐漸重新站穩腳步。由於企業未出現大規模裁員，整體就業市場仍保持一定韌性。
美國政府上周公布，8月非農就業人口大增16.2萬人，創5個月來最大增幅，明顯高於7月增加的2.1萬人；失業率則維持在4.1%不變，顯示企業招聘活動有所回升。
不過，就業市場仍存在隱憂。8月失業時間中位數接近4年半高點，凸顯長期失業問題尚未改善。相較於企業裁員意願偏低，已經失去工作的人可能需要更長時間才能重新就業。
截至8月29日當周，至少連續兩周申領失業救濟的續領失業金人數減少1,000人，經季節調整後降至177.4萬人。這項數據常被視為衡量招聘情況的參考指標，其水準仍顯示企業在招募新員工方面保持謹慎。
paras_en: US initial unemployment claims slipped slightly last week, indicating that corporate layoffs are still at a low level and continue to support the labor market. However, the number of continuing claimants remains relatively high and the median duration of unemployment is near a four‑and‑a‑half‑year peak, reflecting that some job seekers still find it difficult to regain employment.

The US Labor Department announced on Thursday the 10th that, for the week ending September 5, seasonally adjusted initial unemployment claims fell by 1,000 to 206,000, a shade above the Reuters poll of economists that had forecast 205,000.

Since mid‑July, initial claims have stayed within a narrow band of 189,000 to 212,000, showing that after a slowdown from late spring through summer the labor market is gradually regaining footing. Because firms have not carried out large‑scale layoffs, the overall employment market retains a degree of resilience.

The US government reported last week that non‑farm payrolls surged by 162,000 in August, the biggest monthly gain in five months and far above the 21,000 increase in July; the unemployment rate held steady at 4.1%, indicating a pickup in hiring activity.

Nevertheless, the employment picture still harbors concerns. The median duration of unemployment in August hovered near the four‑and‑a‑half‑year high, underscoring that long‑term joblessness has not improved. While firms are reluctant to lay off workers, those who have already lost their jobs may face a longer road back to work.

For the week ending August 29, the number of people receiving continuing unemployment benefits for at least two consecutive weeks fell by 1,000 to a seasonally adjusted 1.774 million. This metric is often used as a gauge of hiring conditions, and its level still suggests that companies remain cautious in hiring new staff.

items.title: 比特幣又被Fed嚇跌！8萬美元屢攻不破 連四日走低
items.title_en: Bitcoin Again Scared Down by the Fed! $80,000 Barrier Remains Unbroken, Four Consecutive Days of Decline
paras: 比特幣(BTC)周四(10日)連續第四個交易日走低，進一步跌破8萬美元。中東緊張局勢再度升溫，國際油價本周突破每桶105美元，加上美國最新通膨數據未能降低聯準會(Fed)升息預期，打擊股票、債券及加密貨幣等風險資產。
比特幣在紐約早盤一度下跌2.1%，觸及76,663.54美元。這波回落仍處於近期交易區間內，尚未形成新一輪向下跌破，但比特幣屢次無法站穩8萬美元，凸顯其延續近期反彈動能仍面臨阻力，美國市場需求也持續不一。
自2月初以來，比特幣大致在6萬至8萬美元之間震盪，遠低於去年10月創下的約12.6萬美元歷史高點。儘管近期一度反彈，但每當價格逼近8萬美元便遭遇賣壓，使該價位成為短期內的重要阻力區。
比特幣周四跌勢在美國生產者物價指數(PPI)公布後進一步加劇。美國勞工統計局(BLS)數據顯示，8月PPI月增0.4%、年增5.4%，顯示批發端通膨壓力仍處高檔。
市場焦點接著轉向周五公布的消費者物價指數(CPI)。市場預期，汽油價格上漲可能推升整體CPI，但核心通膨增幅可能相對溫和。部分Fed官員已暗示，9月15日至16日會議的利率決定，可能取決於本周PPI與CPI數據。
若通膨持續高於預期，Fed升息機率可能進一步上升，推高美債殖利率及美元，對比特幣等不孳息風險資產構成壓力。短期而言，比特幣能否重返並站穩8萬美元，仍將取決於美國通膨數據、Fed政策預期及中東局勢發展。
paras_en: Bitcoin (BTC) fell for a fourth consecutive trading day on Thursday (the 10th), slipping further below $80,000. Renewed tension in the Middle East pushed international oil prices above $105 a barrel this week, and the latest U.S. inflation data failed to ease expectations of further Fed rate hikes, hurting risk assets such as stocks, bonds and cryptocurrencies.

In early New York trading, Bitcoin dropped 2.1% to $76,663.54. The pullback remains within its recent trading range and has not yet triggered a new lower break, but Bitcoin’s repeated inability to hold above $80,000 highlights the resistance it still faces after its recent rebound, while demand in the U.S. market stays uneven.

Since early February, Bitcoin has been oscillating roughly between $60,000 and $80,000, far below the historic peak of about $126,000 set in October last year. Although it briefly rallied recently, each time the price approached $80,000 it met selling pressure, making that level a key short‑term resistance zone.

Bitcoin’s decline on Thursday intensified after the U.S. Producer Price Index (PPI) was released. Data from the Bureau of Labor Statistics showed the August PPI rose 0.4% month‑over‑month and 5.4% year‑over‑year, indicating that wholesale‑sector inflation pressure remains high.

Market attention then shifted to Friday’s Consumer Price Index (CPI) release. The market expects higher gasoline prices to push overall CPI up, while core inflation may rise more modestly. Some Fed officials have hinted that the rate decision at the September 15‑16 meeting could hinge on this week’s PPI and CPI numbers.

If inflation stays above expectations, the odds of another Fed rate hike could rise further, lifting U.S. Treasury yields and the dollar and putting pressure on non‑yield‑bearing risk assets like Bitcoin. In the short term, whether Bitcoin can retake and hold the $80,000 level will depend on U.S. inflation data, Fed policy expectations, and developments in the Middle East.

items.title: 新iPhone補貼戰分兩派！Comcast最高折1,300美元，Verizon反向淡出免費手機
items.title_en: New iPhone Subsidy War Splits Into Two Camps! Comcast Offers Up to $1,300 Discount, Verizon Pulls Back Free Phones
paras: 2026年09月10日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 蘋果Apple(AAPL-US)新一代iPhone上市，美國電信商的搶客策略卻開始分歧。康卡斯特Comcast(CMCSA-US)旗下Xfinity Mobile針對iPhone 18系列祭出最高1,300美元折抵；另一邊，Verizon Communications(VZ-US)則強調降低手機補貼，希望證明不靠「免費手機」也能增加用戶。
Comcast表示，Mobile Plus新舊客戶符合舊機換新條件，可免費取得iPhone 18 Pro Max，或購買其他新款iPhone最高折抵1,300美元；沒有舊機換新的客戶，也可折抵400美元。Mobile Plus月費為45美元，顯示Comcast希望藉新iPhone換機潮，把更多用戶導入行動通訊服務。
相較之下，Verizon執行長Daniel Schulman認為，電信商不需要依賴免費手機吸引或留住客戶，並正將行動資費與手機裝置拆開。公司表示，目前Simplicity方案帶來的大部分新增用戶沒有搭配手機補貼，客戶取得成本也降至3年低點。

paras_en: September 10, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – Apple (AAPL-US) has launched the next‑generation iPhone, and U.S. carriers are already taking divergent approaches to win customers. Comcast’s (CMCSA-US) Xfinity Mobile is offering up to a $1,300 credit for the iPhone 18 series, while Verizon Communications (VZ-US) is emphasizing a reduction in handset subsidies, aiming to prove it can grow its base without “free phones.”

Comcast says that both new and existing Mobile Plus customers who meet the trade‑in criteria can receive a free iPhone 18 Pro Max or get up to a $1,300 discount on other new iPhone models; customers without a trade‑in can still receive a $400 discount. The Mobile Plus plan costs $45 per month, indicating Comcast’s intent to use the iPhone upgrade wave to pull more users onto its mobile service.

In contrast, Verizon CEO Daniel Schulman argues that carriers don’t need to rely on free phones to attract or retain customers and is separating service plans from device subsidies. The company notes that most of the new subscribers on its Simplicity plan have not received handset subsidies, and the acquisition cost per customer has fallen to a three‑year low.

items.title: 油價一飆債市就怕！美債殖利率攀上多年高點 市場提前押注Fed升息
items.title_en: Oil Prices Surge, Bond Market Fears Rise! U.S. Treasury Yields Hit Multi‑Year Highs as Market Bets Early Fed Rate Hike
paras: 國際油價持續飆升，重新點燃市場對通膨與升息的憂慮，美債殖利率周四(10日)全面攀上多年高點。交易員將聯準會(Fed)下周升息的機率提高至約70%，並提前至10月完全反映一次升息，原先市場預期的時間點為12月。
各年期美債殖利率普遍上升6至8個基點，其中30年期美債殖利率升至2007年以來最高，2年期美債殖利率則自2024年以來首度突破4.5%。
指標原油價格大漲逾4%，升至5月以來最高，並逐步逼近美國2月底攻擊伊朗、擾亂中東石油供應後所創高點。能源價格上漲也衝擊全球公債市場，英國2年期公債殖利率攀升逾10個基點。
歐洲公債同樣遭到拋售。歐洲中央銀行(ECB)周四如預期升息1碼(25個基點)，將存款利率調高至2.5%，為美伊戰爭爆發以來第二度升息。ECB表示，這項決定是因通膨預料將在一段較長時間內「遠高於目標」。
美國8月生產者物價指數(PPI)增幅大致符合經濟學家預期，未能舒緩債市賣壓。投資人目前更關注周五公布的消費者物價指數(CPI)，這份數據可能成為Fed在9月16日作出利率決定的關鍵依據。
美債遭拋售也推高30年期公債標售成本。美國財政部周四將重新標售220億美元30年期公債，預估得標殖利率約為5.35%，高於2001年以來任何一次30年期公債標售結果。
財政部隨後預定回購最多60億美元、期限介於10至20年的公債，規模為原先20億美元的3倍。這項擴大回購計畫於8月19日意外宣布，目的在抑制長期美債殖利率上升，但在油價及升息預期夾擊下，目前仍難以扭轉債市跌勢。
paras_en: International oil prices kept climbing, reigniting market worries about inflation and rate hikes, and U.S. Treasury yields rose across the board on Thursday (the 10th) to multi‑year highs. Traders lifted the probability of a Fed rate increase next week to about 70% and moved the market’s expectation of a single hike fully into October, whereas it had previously been slated for December.

Yields on U.S. Treasuries of all maturities rose roughly 6 to 8 basis points, with the 30‑year yield climbing to its highest level since 2007 and the 2‑year yield breaking above 4.5% for the first time since 2024.

Benchmark crude oil prices jumped more than 4%, reaching the highest level since May and edging toward the peak set after the U.S. attacked Iran at the end of February, disrupting Middle‑East oil supplies. The rise in energy prices also hit global sovereign‑bond markets, with the UK 2‑year gilt yield climbing over 10 basis points.

European sovereign bonds were sold off as well. The European Central Bank on Thursday, as expected, raised rates by one step (25 basis points), lifting the deposit rate to 2.5% – the second rate hike since the outbreak of the U.S.–Iran conflict. The ECB said the move was driven by inflation that is expected to stay "far above target" for an extended period.

U.S. August producer‑price index (PPI) growth was roughly in line with economists’ forecasts, failing to ease selling pressure in the bond market. Investors are now focused on Friday’s consumer‑price index (CPI) release, which could become the key data point guiding the Fed’s rate decision on September 16.

The sell‑off in Treasuries also pushed up the cost of re‑issuing 30‑year bonds. The U.S. Treasury announced on Thursday a new 30‑year auction of $22 billion, with an expected winning yield of about 5.35%, higher than any 30‑year auction result since 2001.

The Treasury subsequently plans to repurchase up to $6 billion of bonds with maturities between 10 and 20 years – three times the original $2 billion size. The expanded buy‑back, announced unexpectedly on August 19, was intended to curb the rise in long‑term Treasury yields, but amid soaring oil prices and rate‑hike expectations it has so far been unable to reverse the bond market’s decline.

paras: 美股主要指數周四(10日)開盤走低，美國8月生產者物價指數(PPI)年增率高於預期，加上中東戰事升級推動美國油價突破每桶100美元、布蘭特原油站上105美元，升高通膨與經濟成長疑慮。

items.title_en: Oracle Earnings Debut: Stock Expected to Swing Up to 11%?
paras: 甲骨文(Oracle)(ORCL-US)預計將於周四(10日)美股收盤後公布財報，交易員正預期這家資料庫與雲端基礎設施巨頭的股價將出現大幅波動。甲骨文股價周三收盤下跌0.5%，至每股161.63美元。
《Investopedia》報導，根據近期選擇權價格，市場預期甲骨文股價在本周結束前可能上下波動最多達11%。從周三收盤價計算，若出現如此幅度的漲幅，股價最高可能升至179美元，收復今年部分跌幅。若下跌，則可能跌破145美元。
甲骨文股價2026年以來已下跌近20%，較去年9月創下的歷史高點更已下跌超過50%。市場對公司籌資與支出計畫感到擔憂，同時擔心其未交訂單(backlog)過度集中於少數大型AI企業。
在市場持續擔憂AI泡沫的情況下，甲骨文周四公布的財報可能面臨較高的投資人期待。
摩根士丹利分析師目前給予甲骨文「中立」評級，並在近期報告中警告，甲骨文可能需要連續數季交出穩健的財報表現，才能重新贏得抱持疑慮的投資人信心。花旗分析師則告訴客戶，他們「認為在股價經歷公司歷史上最極端的失衡與跌幅之一後，市場反而出現了機會」。
市場預期，甲骨文第一財季營收將年增28%，達190.6億美元。調整後每股盈餘(EPS)預計為1.74美元，高於去年同期的1.47美元。根據Visible Alpha彙整的預估，甲骨文未交訂單預計已增至近6,400億美元，年增40%。
華爾街多數分析師仍看好甲骨文。Visible Alpha追蹤的11名分析師中，有9人給予「買進」評級，另有1人評為「中立」、1人評為「賣出」。這些分析師的平均目標價為239美元，意味著相較周三收盤價，股價仍有近50%的上漲空間。
paras_en: Oracle (ORCL-US) is slated to release its earnings after the U.S. market close on Thursday (the 10th), and traders are anticipating a sharp move in the stock of the database and cloud infrastructure giant. Oracle’s shares closed Wednesday down 0.5% at $161.63 per share.

Investopedia reports that, based on recent options pricing, the market expects Oracle’s stock could swing as much as 11% by the end of the week. From Wednesday’s close, an upside of that magnitude would push the price to as high as $179, recouping part of this year’s losses, while a downside could see it dip below $145.

Oracle’s stock has fallen nearly 20% since 2026 and is more than 50% off its historic peak set in September last year. Investors are worried about the company’s financing and spending plans and are also concerned that its backlog is overly concentrated in a few large AI customers.
With the market still uneasy about an AI bubble, Oracle’s Thursday earnings could face heightened investor expectations.

Morgan Stanley analysts currently rate Oracle “Neutral” and warned in a recent note that the company may need several consecutive quarters of solid earnings to win back skeptical investors. Citi analysts told clients they “see an opportunity now that the stock has experienced one of the most extreme imbalances and declines in its history.”

The market expects Oracle’s fiscal Q1 revenue to grow 28% year‑over‑year to $19.06 billion, with adjusted earnings per share of $1.74, up from $1.47 a year ago. Visible Alpha’s consensus forecasts a backlog that has risen to about $640 billion, a 40% annual increase.

Most Wall Street analysts remain bullish on Oracle. Of the 11 analysts tracked by Visible Alpha, nine rate the stock “Buy,” one rates it “Neutral,” and one rates it “Sell.” Their average price target is $239, implying roughly a 50% upside from Wednesday’s closing price.
