items.title: 美軍不是宣稱摧毀九成？伊朗地下工廠重啟飛彈生產
items.title_en: U.S. Not Claiming 90% Destruction? Iran’s Underground Factories Restart Missile Production
paras: 伊朗已利用戰前囤積的零組件，在地下設施恢復生產彈道飛彈，削弱美國與以色列宣稱已重創伊朗飛彈工業的戰果。美國及中東官員透露，德黑蘭目前雖只能以較低速度組裝飛彈，但可能仍有足夠零件生產數百枚武器，並正興建新的地下組裝據點，以躲避後續空襲。
《華爾街日報》(WSJ)周四(10日)援引知情官員消息報導，情報顯示伊朗多處地下設施重新出現生產活動，包括位於伊朗東南部的霍吉爾(Khojir)飛彈設施。伊朗正組裝液態燃料與固態燃料飛彈，前者須在發射前加注燃料，後者則可長時間儲存並隨時發射。

地下工廠恢復運作 美以戰果受到質疑

美國與以色列2月28日發動戰爭後，曾對伊朗飛彈生產基地、倉儲設施、飛彈及發射器進行數千次打擊，並破壞多座製造飛彈零件與成品所需的工業設施。美國海上封鎖也增加伊朗進口零件及固態燃料原料的難度。
不過，伊朗趁夏季戰事相對平靜期間修復軍事能力，並認為停火難以長久維持。一名美國官員表示，伊朗可能在6月中旬與川普簽署初步協議、同意開放荷姆茲海峽並展開結束戰爭談判後，便恢復低速生產。
白宮官員未直接回應伊朗是否重啟彈道飛彈生產，僅表示伊朗核設施已遭摧毀，軍事力量也受到嚴重削弱。美國國防部首席發言人帕內爾(Sean Parnell)則稱，美軍已摧毀伊朗最多90%的無人機、彈道飛彈及海軍工業基礎，並大幅削弱其發射飛彈與無人機的能力。
美國國防部長赫格塞斯(Pete Hegseth)4月也曾宣稱，伊朗飛彈計畫在功能上已被摧毀，既無國防工業，也沒有補充攻擊及防禦能力的手段。如今伊朗恢復組裝飛彈，顯示徹底瓦解其分散且深入地下的生產體系，遠比美方原先宣稱的更加困難。
美國飛彈防禦倡議聯盟(Missile Defense Advocacy Alliance)資深分析師Tal Inbar表示，只要轟炸一度停止，伊朗就能修復受損基礎設施，從其他國家取得新零件並存放於地下設施；若認為伊朗不會重建飛彈產能，未免過度天真。

零件庫存可組裝數百枚 消耗戰能力仍在

美國及區域官員表示，伊朗現階段主要使用既有零組件組裝新飛彈，產量仍低於戰前水準。倫敦國王學院訪問研究員、前美國中央情報局(CIA)伊朗軍事分析師Jim Lamson指出，伊朗戰前便囤積成品彈頭、飛彈彈體，以及導引與控制系統等零件。
過往由伊朗公布的影像顯示，大批飛彈零件整齊排列在地下設施牆邊。伊朗究竟能生產多少新飛彈，取決於零件庫存深度及仍可運作的地下設施數量。Lamson估計，可能是數百枚，也可能多達數千枚。
伊朗在戰爭期間消耗大量成品飛彈，迫使其降低攻擊規模，但整體能力尚未耗盡。Tal Inbar估計，伊朗目前的彈道飛彈庫存仍達數千枚。
伊朗持續對中東各地美軍基地發射飛彈，展示武器種類的多樣性，其中Kheibar Shekan飛彈具備機動性、精準度較高且製造成本相對低廉。伊朗周三對駐有美軍的約旦一處空軍基地發動大規模攻擊，影像顯示部分飛彈搭載集束彈頭，這類武器在戰爭初期也曾頻繁用於挑戰以色列防空系統。
伊朗飛彈產能恢復，也有助其繼續投入消耗戰，與美國及波斯灣國家逐漸縮減的飛彈攔截器庫存周旋。阿拉伯國家與以色列官員正為戰事延續及伊朗升高攻勢預作準備。伊朗近日並多次攻擊美國軍艦，雖未命中，但曾數度險些造成重大損失。

全面復產仍有障礙 但重建速度令人憂心

衛星影像顯示，伊朗正快速重建橋梁、道路及飛彈生產據點，也已重新打通遭美以空襲炸塌的飛彈基地隧道入口。以色列軍方研判，儲存在地下設施內的武器可能保存良好。
不過，伊朗若要全面恢復飛彈製造，仍面臨若干障礙，包括生產液態推進劑所需的化學設施受損，以及製造固態燃料所需的工業攪拌設備不足。美國封鎖也持續限制零件與原料輸入。
伊朗因缺乏現代化空軍，自1980年代兩伊戰爭期間便開始建立飛彈計畫，並逐漸將其視為嚇阻敵人的核心武力。2025年6月與以色列爆發12天戰爭後，伊朗也曾以快於預期的速度補充飛彈庫存，迫使以色列在同年底警告，可能有必要再次發動攻擊。
巴黎政治學院(Sciences Po)伊朗戰略專家Nicole Grajewski指出，飛彈生產能力比核計畫更容易恢復，而且相關設施高度分散。伊朗當初建立複雜且深入地下的飛彈基礎設施，正是為了在遭受攻擊後仍能保存並重建戰力。
paras_en: Iran has used pre‑war stockpiled components to resume ballistic missile production in underground facilities, undermining U.S. and Israeli claims of having crippled Iran’s missile industry. U.S. and Middle‑East officials say Tehran can currently assemble missiles at a slower pace but may still have enough parts to produce hundreds of weapons and is building new underground assembly sites to evade further air strikes.

The Wall Street Journal reported on Thursday (the 10th) that intelligence shows multiple Iranian underground sites have resumed production activity, including the Khojir missile facility in southeastern Iran. Iran is assembling both liquid‑fuel and solid‑fuel missiles; the former must be fueled before launch, while the latter can be stored for long periods and launched at any time.

The revival of underground factories calls U.S.‑Israeli war gains into question. After the February 28 war, the United States and Israel carried out thousands of strikes on Iranian missile production bases, storage sites, missiles and launchers, destroying many industrial facilities needed to make missile components and finished weapons. The U.S. naval blockade has also made it harder for Iran to import parts and solid‑fuel raw materials.

However, Iran used the relatively quiet summer period to repair its military capability and believes a cease‑fire cannot last long. A U.S. official said Iran could resume low‑rate production after a mid‑June preliminary agreement with Trump to reopen the Hormuz Strait and begin war‑ending talks.

White House officials did not directly answer whether Iran has restarted ballistic missile production, only noting that Iran’s nuclear facilities have been destroyed and its military strength severely weakened. Pentagon spokesperson Sean Parnell said the U.S. has destroyed up to 90% of Iran’s drones, ballistic missiles and naval industrial base, greatly reducing its ability to launch missiles and drones.

Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth also claimed in April that Iran’s missile program had been functionally destroyed, with no defense industry and no means to replenish offensive or defensive capabilities. Iran’s current missile assembly shows that fully dismantling its dispersed, deep‑underground production system is far harder than the U.S. originally claimed.

Tal Inbar, a senior analyst at the Missile Defense Advocacy Alliance, said that once bombing stops, Iran can repair damaged infrastructure, obtain new parts from abroad and store them underground; assuming Iran will not rebuild missile capacity would be overly naïve.

U.S. and regional officials say Iran is now mainly using existing stockpiled components to assemble new missiles, with output still below pre‑war levels. Jim Lamson, a researcher at King’s College London and former CIA Iran military analyst, noted that Iran had stockpiled complete warheads, missile bodies and guidance and control systems before the war.

Images released by Iran in the past show large numbers of missile parts neatly arranged along the walls of underground facilities. How many new missiles Iran can produce depends on the depth of its parts inventory and the number of underground sites still operational. Lamson estimates the figure could be in the hundreds, or possibly up to several thousand.

During the war Iran burned through a large stock of finished missiles, forcing it to scale back attacks, but its overall capability has not been exhausted. Tal Inbar estimates Iran still has several thousand ballistic missiles in its inventory.

Iran continues to fire missiles at U.S. bases across the Middle East, showcasing a variety of weapon types. The Kheibar Shekan missile is noted for its mobility, higher accuracy and relatively low cost. On Wednesday Iran launched a large‑scale attack on a U.S.‑occupied air base in Jordan, with footage showing some missiles carrying cluster munitions, a weapon used early in the war to challenge Israeli air defenses.

The revival of Iran’s missile capacity also helps it sustain a war of attrition against the United States and Gulf states, whose missile interceptor stocks are gradually dwindling. Arab and Israeli officials are preparing for a prolonged conflict and a heightened Iranian offensive. Iran has recently made several attacks on U.S. warships that missed but came close to causing serious damage.

Satellite imagery shows Iran rapidly rebuilding bridges, roads and missile production sites, and has reopened tunnel entrances to missile bases that were collapsed by U.S.–Israeli air strikes. Israeli military analysts assess that weapons stored in underground facilities may be in good condition.

Nevertheless, fully restoring missile production faces several hurdles, including damaged chemical plants needed for liquid‑propellant production and a shortage of industrial mixers required for solid‑fuel manufacturing. The U.S. blockade continues to limit the import of parts and raw materials.

Lacking a modern air force, Iran began its missile program in the 1980s during the Iran‑Iraq war and has increasingly treated missiles as its core deterrent force. After a 12‑day war with Israel in June 2025, Iran replenished its missile stock faster than expected, prompting Israel at the end of that year to warn that another attack might become necessary.

Nicole Grajewski, an Iran strategy expert at Sciences Po, said missile production capacity is easier to restore than a nuclear program and that related facilities are highly dispersed. Iran’s original strategy of building complex, deep‑underground missile infrastructure was intended to preserve and rebuild combat power after an attack.

items.title: AI下一個大商機來了？黃仁勳點名新戰場：網路安全
items.title_en: AI’s Next Big Business Opportunity? Jensen Huang Names New Battlefield: Cybersecurity
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)共同創辦人暨執行長黃仁勳(Jensen Huang)表示，網路安全可能成為人工智慧(AI)下一個主要應用市場。隨著AI自動生成程式碼的能力快速進步，軟體漏洞被利用及需要修補的速度同步加快，預料將顛覆現有網路安全產業。
黃仁勳周四(10日)在舊金山舉行的高盛(GS-US)科技會議上表示，「網路安全很可能是AI下一個重大應用領域」。他指出，AI模型使程式設計走向自動化，也讓安全漏洞出現、遭到攻擊及必須修復的速度大幅提升，企業對AI資安工具的需求將隨之增加。
談到AI既創造問題又催生市場需求時，黃仁勳說，還有什麼方式比創造問題更能製造需求？任何公司都希望市場急切需要自家產品，甚至排隊搶購，但業者可以選擇負責任的做法，也可能採取較不理想的方式。
黃仁勳此次面對投資人發言前，輝達上月才公布強勁的長期展望，進一步鞏固華爾街對AI資料中心支出將持續擴大的信心，並強化市場對輝達長期受惠的預期。不過，科技產業仍不斷被要求證明，投入AI基礎設施的龐大資本支出確實能創造經濟效益。
輝達持續進行投資與併購，也引發外界擔憂公司可能扭曲AI市場。輝達上周宣布，將以約130億美元收購AI新創Hugging Face，藉此把業務版圖從晶片進一步擴展至AI產業其他領域。
對於部分交易可能形成循環投資的質疑，黃仁勳予以否認。他表示，輝達投入少量資金後，最終能帶回更多收益，並稱市場開始意識到，輝達投資的領域通常也是值得投資的方向，因為公司掌握客戶真正需要滿足的基礎需求。
黃仁勳強調，輝達動用公司資金前，必須確認投資標的是一筆「穩賺的交易」。若一家潛在投資對象要符合這項標準，輝達必須先看到已有客戶準備採用其產品或服務，而不是僅憑市場題材承擔風險。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) co‑founder and CEO Jensen Huang said that cybersecurity could become the next major application market for artificial intelligence (AI). As AI’s ability to automatically generate code advances rapidly, the speed at which software vulnerabilities are exploited and need to be patched is accelerating, which is expected to disrupt the existing cybersecurity industry.

On Thursday (the 10th) at Goldman Sachs’ (GS-US) technology conference in San Francisco, Huang stated, “Cybersecurity is very likely to be AI’s next major application area.” He noted that AI models are automating software development and also dramatically increasing the speed at which security flaws appear, are attacked, and must be fixed, driving greater corporate demand for AI‑powered security tools.

When discussing how AI both creates problems and spawns market demand, Huang remarked that nothing creates demand faster than creating problems. Every company wants the market to urgently need its product, even to the point of queuing for purchases, but firms can choose a responsible approach or a less desirable one.

Before speaking to investors, NVIDIA had just released a strong long‑term outlook last month, further cementing Wall Street’s confidence that AI data‑center spending will continue to grow and reinforcing expectations that NVIDIA will benefit over the long run. However, the tech sector is still being asked to prove that the massive capital outlays for AI infrastructure truly generate economic returns.

NVIDIA’s ongoing investments and acquisitions have also raised concerns that the company could distort the AI market. Last week NVIDIA announced it would acquire AI startup Hugging Face for about $13 billion, extending its business beyond chips into other areas of the AI industry.

Addressing doubts that some deals might create a circular investment pattern, Huang denied the notion. He said that after NVIDIA puts in a modest amount of capital, it can ultimately bring back greater returns, and noted that the market is beginning to recognize that the areas NVIDIA invests in are usually worthwhile because the company understands the fundamental needs of its customers.

Huang emphasized that before deploying company funds, NVIDIA must confirm that an investment target is a “sure‑bet.” For a potential investment to meet this criterion, NVIDIA must first see existing customers ready to adopt the target’s products or services, rather than taking a risk based solely on market hype.

items.title: AI開始替人類探月！IBM、NASA聯手找冰層、挑登陸點
items.title_en: AI Begins Moon Exploration for Humanity! IBM and NASA Team Up to Locate Ice and Choose Landing Sites
paras: IBM(IBM-US)與美國航太總署(NASA)周四(10日)共同推出開源AI工具「NASA-IBM月球基礎模型」(NASA-IBM Lunar Foundation Model)，協助科學家分析數十年累積的月球觀測資料，並為人類長期進駐月球及未來火星任務提供支援。
這套模型利用NASA四項太空任務、九具觀測儀器蒐集的逾30層資料進行訓練，其中包括月球勘測軌道飛行器(Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter)取得的數據，目前已開放研究人員使用。
NASA-IBM月球基礎模型加入IBM與NASA共同開發的Prithvi開放式基礎模型系列，該系列應用範圍涵蓋地理空間、天氣及其他科學研究領域。
這套模型可協助研究人員辨識月球永久陰影區內可能存在的冰層、繪製隕石坑分布圖以選擇安全登陸地點，並分析月球表面的火山地形。這些工作過去通常需要科學家人工檢查大量地圖與影像，或仰賴解析度較低的機器學習工具。
NASA與IBM表示，在基準測試中，這套AI模型辨識月球表面重要特徵的準確度，最高比目前廣泛使用的方法提升23%，有望加快月球地質研究及登陸地點評估。
各國太空機構尤其重視月球冰層，因其代表可能存在可利用的水與氧氣。這些資源不僅是興建月球基地及維持太空人長期生活的關鍵，也可能用來製造火箭燃料，支援未來前往火星的任務。
NASA阿提米絲(Artemis)計畫預定2028年再次把太空人送上月球，測試建立人類長期駐留能力所需的新技術，並為後續火星探索任務奠定基礎。
paras_en: IBM (IBM-US) and NASA on Thursday (the 10th) jointly launched an open‑source AI tool called the “NASA‑IBM Lunar Foundation Model” to help scientists analyze decades of accumulated lunar observation data and to support humanity’s long‑term presence on the Moon as well as future Mars missions.

The model was trained on more than 30 layers of data gathered by NASA’s four space missions and nine instruments, including data obtained by the Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter, and it is now available for researchers to use.

The NASA‑IBM Lunar Foundation Model incorporates the Prithvi open‑foundation model series co‑developed by IBM and NASA, a series whose applications span geospatial, weather, and other scientific research domains.

The model can assist researchers in identifying possible ice deposits in permanently shadowed regions, mapping crater distributions to select safe landing sites, and analyzing volcanic terrain on the lunar surface. These tasks previously required scientists to manually examine large amounts of maps and images or rely on lower‑resolution machine‑learning tools.

NASA and IBM state that in benchmark tests the AI model’s accuracy in identifying important lunar surface features is up to 23% higher than the widely used methods currently, promising to accelerate lunar geological research and landing‑site evaluation.

Space agencies worldwide place particular emphasis on lunar ice because it may represent usable water and oxygen. These resources are not only key to building lunar bases and sustaining astronauts over the long term, but could also be used to produce rocket fuel to support future missions to Mars.

NASA’s Artemis program is scheduled to send astronauts back to the Moon in 2028, testing new technologies needed for sustained human presence and laying the groundwork for subsequent Mars exploration missions.

items.title: 美債殖利率狂飆 市場緊盯小型股是否成第一張骨牌
items.title_en: U.S. Treasury Yields Surge, Market Watches Whether Small Caps Are the First Domino
paras: 隨著小型股跌破關鍵技術價位，再度成為市場關注焦點，投資人正密切觀察全球債券殖利率攀升，是否會對股市帶來更大壓力。
市場普遍認為，小型股對利率變化較為敏感。因此，如果較高的借貸成本開始拖累小型股，可能是美國整體股市壓力升高的早期警訊。相較於大型企業，小型企業通常更依賴舉債支應營運，尤其是浮動利率債務。
羅素2000指數跌破50日均線
今年稍早表現大幅領先大型股後，小型股羅素2000指數近幾周開始陷入疲弱，標普500指數等其他主要指數則大致呈現橫盤整理。
根據 FactSet 資料，羅素2000指數涵蓋近2,000家規模最小的企業，成分股平均市值約19億美元；相較之下，標普500指數成分股平均市值約1,462億美元。
羅素2000指數周三再度走低，延續近期跌勢。FactSet 資料顯示，該指數上月底已跌破市場密切關注的50日移動平均線。由於50日均線通常被視為短期趨勢指標，跌破這項關鍵門檻可能意味後續仍有下跌空間。
自第三季開始以來，羅素2000指數已轉為下跌。根據道瓊市場數據，該指數目前可能寫下2025年初以來首次單季下跌。
油價與美債殖利率齊升 股市承壓
隨著原油價格與美國公債殖利率延續漲勢，美股周三持續承壓。芝商所（CME）FedWatch 工具顯示，聯邦基金期貨交易員預估，聯準會（Fed）下周升息的機率約為62%。
作為美國大型股主要指標的標普500指數周三同樣下跌，並逐漸逼近50日移動平均線。
羅素2000指數近期轉弱，可能加深部分投資人對整體市場的擔憂。在通膨持續僵固之際，Fed未來利率政策走向仍充滿不確定性。不過，市場仍有樂觀的理由，小型企業和大型企業一樣，都受惠於獲利強勁成長的預期。
專注投資中小型股的 Calamos Investments 資深投資組合經理 Brandon Nelson 表示，企業獲利強勁成長的跡象，是小型股今年稍早領先大盤的重要動力。
Nelson認為，近期回檔反而可能為年底前的強勁反彈創造更有利條件。
他在電話訪問中表示：「如果接下來幾周市場持續在目前水準震盪，我不會感到意外。我們正在為第四季可能出現的另一波漲勢打下基礎。」他並表示，自己對基本面仍相當樂觀。
近期歷史表現也對年底前的股市帶來正面訊號。根據道瓊市場數據，過去20年來，羅素2000指數在第四季的平均表現，優於標普500指數及另一項美國大型股指標羅素1000指數。若將時間拉長至1987年以來，這三項指數第四季平均漲幅則大致相近，且均呈現正報酬。
升息一碼未必引發市場恐慌
Nelson表示，第四季來臨前，股市仍面臨不少疑慮，包括伊朗衝突持續，以及交易員預期Fed可能考慮升息，以推動通膨回落至2%目標。
不過，他認為，即使Fed在9月升息，也不太可能代表新一輪積極升息循環的開始。央行若僅將政策利率調高1碼，幅度似乎不足以讓股市陷入恐慌。
Nelson表示：「我們目前並未採取防禦性布局。我認為，市場正蓄勢在第四季迎來一波大行情。」
paras_en: As small caps slip below a key technical level and regain market focus, investors are closely watching the rise in global bond yields to see if it will add further pressure on equities.

The market generally believes small caps are more sensitive to rate changes. Thus, if higher borrowing costs begin to weigh on small caps, it could be an early warning sign of rising pressure on the broader U.S. market. Compared with large firms, small companies usually rely more on debt to fund operations, especially floating‑rate debt.
Russell 2000 Index falls below its 50‑day moving average

After earlier outperformance of large‑cap stocks this year, the small‑cap Russell 2000 has been weakening over the past few weeks, while the S&P 500 and other major indices have largely been trading sideways.

According to FactSet, the Russell 2000 covers roughly 2,000 of the smallest companies, with an average market cap of about $1.9 billion; by contrast, the average market cap of S&P 500 constituents is about $146.2 billion.

The Russell 2000 slipped lower again on Wednesday, extending its recent decline. FactSet data show the index broke below the closely watched 50‑day moving average at the end of last month. Because the 50‑day line is often seen as a short‑term trend indicator, breaching this key threshold could signal further downside potential.
Since the start of the third quarter, the Russell 2000 has turned negative. Dow Jones market data suggest the index may be logging its first quarterly decline since early 2025.
Oil prices and U.S. Treasury yields rise together, weighing on stocks

With oil prices and U.S. Treasury yields continuing to climb, U.S. equities remained under pressure on Wednesday. CME’s FedWatch tool shows futures traders estimate a roughly 62% chance the Fed will raise rates next week.
The S&P 500, the main gauge for large‑cap U.S. stocks, also fell on Wednesday and is edging toward its 50‑day moving average.

The recent weakness in the Russell 2000 may deepen some investors’ concerns about the overall market. With inflation staying stubbornly high, the Fed’s future rate path remains uncertain. Nonetheless, there are optimistic reasons: both small and large firms stand to benefit from expectations of strong earnings growth.

Brandon Nelson, a senior portfolio manager at Calamos Investments who focuses on mid‑ and small‑cap stocks, said that signs of robust earnings growth were a key driver of small caps’ earlier outperformance versus the broader market.
Nelson believes the recent pullback could actually set up more favorable conditions for a strong rebound before year‑end.

He told reporters on a call, “If the market continues to oscillate around current levels over the next few weeks, I wouldn’t be surprised. We’re laying the groundwork for another rally in the fourth quarter.” He added that he remains quite optimistic on the fundamentals.

Recent historical performance also sends a positive signal for the market before year‑end. Dow Jones data show that over the past 20 years the Russell 2000’s average fourth‑quarter return has outperformed both the S&P 500 and the Russell 1000, another large‑cap benchmark. Extending the view back to 1987, the three indices have posted similar average gains in Q4 and all have delivered positive returns.
Rate hikes of a single basis point may not spark market panic

Nelson noted that ahead of the fourth quarter, the market still faces several concerns, including the ongoing Iran conflict and traders’ expectations that the Fed may consider a rate hike to bring inflation back down to its 2% target.

However, he argues that even if the Fed raises rates in September, it is unlikely to signal the start of a new aggressive tightening cycle. A one‑basis‑point increase in the policy rate would probably be too modest to frighten the market.
Nelson said, “We are not currently taking defensive positions. I think the market is building momentum for a big move in the fourth quarter.”

items.title: 【遊戲產業】沙烏地再出手！傳擬整併EA與Savvy Games，打造橫跨3A、體育與手遊的遊戲巨頭
items.title_en: Gaming Industry: Saudi Arabia Strikes Again! Rumors of Merging EA and Savvy Games to Create a Giant Across AAA, Sports, and Mobile Gaming
paras: 2026年09月11日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 沙烏地阿拉伯主權財富基金(PIF)持續加碼全球遊戲產業。據彭博報導，PIF正在評估將Electronic Arts(EA)與Savvy Games合併，若交易成行，旗下遊戲版圖將一次涵蓋EA Sports FC、Battlefield、The Sims，以及Monopoly Go!、Pokémon GO等熱門遊戲。
這項潛在整併的背景，是PIF才剛在上月透過財團以約550億美元收購EA並將其私有化。由於EA與Savvy Games目前都由PIF控制，進一步合併可望把EA在PC、主機與體育遊戲的優勢，與Savvy在手機遊戲市場的布局整合在同一平台。
Savvy本身也還在擴張。公司目前正進行以60億美元收購中國手機遊戲商沐瞳科技(Moonton)的交易，因此EA與Savvy的合併預計最快也要等這筆收購完成後才可能推進，目前尚未做出最終決定。
全球遊戲業在疫情後成長放緩，業者陸續削減成本與裁員，大型遊戲商也透過併購擴大產品陣容與用戶規模。若PIF最終整合EA、Savvy與Moonton，沙烏地的遊戲布局將從投資單一公司，進一步擴大至主機、PC、體育遊戲與手遊市場。

paras_en: September 11, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Saudi Arabia’s sovereign wealth fund (PIF) continues to increase its stake in the global gaming industry. According to Bloomberg, PIF is evaluating a merger of Electronic Arts (EA) with Savvy Games. If the deal goes through, its gaming portfolio would instantly cover hit titles such as EA Sports FC, Battlefield, The Sims, as well as Monopoly Go! and Pokémon GO.

The backdrop to this potential consolidation is that PIF only last month, through a consortium, bought EA for roughly $55 billion and took it private. Because both EA and Savvy Games are now under PIF’s control, a further merger could combine EA’s strengths in PC, console and sports games with Savvy’s footprint in the mobile gaming market on a single platform.

Savvy is also still expanding. The company is currently working on a $6 billion acquisition of Chinese mobile game developer Moonton. Consequently, the EA‑Savvy merger is expected to move forward only after that acquisition is completed, and no final decision has been made yet.

The global gaming industry’s post‑pandemic growth has slowed, prompting operators to cut costs and lay off staff, while large publishers use acquisitions to broaden their product line‑ups and user bases. If PIF ultimately integrates EA, Savvy and Moonton, Saudi Arabia’s gaming strategy would shift from investing in a single company to spanning console, PC, sports and mobile game markets.

items.title: 通膨壓不住、經濟又怕衰退！歐洲央行利率是否衝3% 分析師吵翻天
items.title_en: Inflation Unchecked, Economy Fears Recession! Will ECB Rates Hit 3%? Analysts Clash
paras: 歐洲中央銀行(ECB)周四(10日)如預期升息1碼(25個基點)，將存款利率調高至2.5%，為今年第二度升息，以因應美伊戰爭推升能源價格所帶來的通膨壓力。ECB雖未承諾後續行動，但分析師對本輪升息是否已近尾聲看法不一：部分認為年底前可能再度升息，另一些則警告，能源衝擊終將拖累成長，市場押注利率逼近3%可能過頭。
市場反應方面，歐元兌美元下跌0.3%至約1.159美元，歐元區公債殖利率升至多年高點，歐洲Stoxx 600指數下跌0.7%；油價則大漲逾4%至每桶105.3美元。

鷹派認為升息尚未結束 年底前可能再出手

德意志銀行(DB-US)首席歐洲經濟學家Mark Wall表示，通膨風險正在上升，ECB於12月再次升息的可能性或許已超過按兵不動。不過，ECB仍須謹慎行事，因歐元區經濟過去半年雖展現韌性，天然氣價格迅速上漲造成的負面供給衝擊正逐漸累積，最終勢必傷害成長，問題只在影響程度及何時浮現。
Saltmarsh Economics歐洲經濟學家Marchel Alexandrovich指出，ECB在三個月內第二度升息，並暗示未來幾次會議可能需要進一步緊縮。ECB雖未預先承諾升息，但最新預測顯示，2028年核心通膨仍達2.3%，高於6月預估的2.2%，意味若要讓通膨在中期回到2%目標，可能還需要繼續升息。
摩根大通私人銀行(JPMorgan Private Bank)(JPM-US)宏觀投資策略師Patrick Ernst認為，年底前再升息已不再只是低機率風險。中東衝突再次升級，推動油氣價格明顯上漲、美債遭到拋售，市場對主要央行繼續緊縮的預期也同步升高。
Ernst表示，ECB本次升息符合預期，但真正重要的是決策聲明仍為進一步緊縮保留空間，顯示能源引發的通膨風險依然存在，「這次升息並不是利率上限」，後續走向將高度取決於地緣政治局勢。
標普全球評級(S&P Global Ratings)(SPGI-US)歐洲、中東及非洲首席經濟學家Sylvain Broyer也表示，這次升息不只是預防性措施。歐洲通膨前景在夏季期間已經惡化，不僅供給衝擊增加，需求也愈來愈可能推升物價，因此ECB可能必須把利率調至具有限制性的水準，現階段不能排除繼續升息。

成長風險逐漸浮現 市場押注3%恐怕過頭

施羅德(Schroders)全球經濟主管David Rees則持較審慎看法。他指出，能源價格上漲將使整體通膨維持高檔，但核心通膨目前仍受控制，內需也正在轉弱；能源與融資成本同步上升，可能進一步壓抑歐元區經濟，2027年受到的衝擊尤其明顯。
Rees認為，儘管ECB聲明及經濟預測偏向鷹派，但再次升息的門檻仍高，本次行動更像本輪最後一次升息，而非長期升息周期的起點。除非經濟成長與通膨再次顯著加速，市場不應直接認定利率將朝3%邁進。
Quilter Cheviot固定收益研究主管Richard Carter表示，ECB面臨的平衡難題愈來愈棘手。歐元區部分地區成長仍然脆弱，決策官員必須在抑制通膨與避免進一步打擊經濟之間權衡。停滯性通膨雖尚未成為基本情境，但成長轉弱與通膨壓力重燃的組合，已愈來愈難以忽視。
Aviva Investors利率主管Ed Hutchings認為，ECB眼前首要任務確實是控制通膨，因此市場預期還會升息並非沒有道理。不過，在ECB已升息兩次、市場又反映超過兩次後續升息的情況下，投資人的緊縮押注可能已走得太遠。
富達國際(Fidelity International)歐元區經濟學家Conor Parle則提醒，天然氣及燃料價格上漲將促使ECB密切觀察物價壓力是否擴散。近期熱浪及供應鏈影響可能推高食品通膨，薪資追蹤指標也顯示薪資成長略微加速，決策官員將關注是否出現能源衝擊擴散至其他價格的早期跡象。
paras_en: The European Central Bank (ECB) on Thursday (the 10th) raised rates as expected by one quarter-point (25 basis points), lifting the deposit rate to 2.5%, marking its second hike this year to counter inflation pressure from higher energy prices driven by the US‑Iran war. The ECB did not pledge further action, and analysts are divided on whether this round of tightening is near its end: some think another hike could come before year‑end, while others warn that the energy shock will eventually drag down growth and that markets may be over‑betting on rates approaching 3%.

In market reaction, the euro fell 0.3% against the dollar to about $1.159, euro‑area sovereign yields rose to multi‑year highs, the European Stoxx 600 slipped 0.7%, and oil surged more than 4% to $105.3 a barrel.

Hawkish voices say the tightening is not over and another move may come before year‑end. Deutsche Bank (DB‑US) chief European economist Mark Wall said inflation risks are rising and the odds that the ECB will hike again in December may now exceed the odds of holding steady. Still, the ECB must act cautiously because, although the euro‑area economy has shown resilience over the past six months, the negative supply shock from rapidly rising natural‑gas prices is accumulating and will eventually hurt growth; the question is how severe and when it will materialise.

Saltmarsh Economics European economist Marchel Alexandrovich noted that the ECB’s second hike within three months hints that further tightening may be needed in upcoming meetings. While the ECB has not pre‑committed to more hikes, its latest forecasts show core inflation still at 2.3% in 2028, up from a June estimate of 2.2%, implying that bringing inflation back to the 2% target in the medium term may still require additional rate rises.

JPMorgan Private Bank (JPM‑US) macro investment strategist Patrick Ernst said a rate hike before year‑end is no longer a low‑probability risk. The renewed escalation of the Middle‑East conflict has pushed oil and gas prices sharply higher, U.S. Treasuries have been sold off, and market expectations for continued tightening by major central banks have risen in tandem.

Ernst added that the ECB’s move was in line with expectations, but the crucial point is that the policy statement still leaves room for further tightening, showing that inflation risks from energy remain. “This hike is not a ceiling on rates,” he said, and the path forward will depend heavily on geopolitical developments.

S&P Global Ratings (SPGI‑US) Europe, Middle East and Africa chief economist Sylvain Broyer also said the hike is more than a precautionary step. Europe’s inflation outlook worsened over the summer, with both supply shocks intensifying and demand increasingly likely to push prices up, so the ECB may have to lift rates to a restrictive level and cannot rule out further hikes at this stage.

Schroders global economics head David Rees took a more cautious view. He noted that higher energy prices will keep overall inflation elevated, but core inflation is still under control and domestic demand is weakening; the simultaneous rise in energy costs and financing costs could further suppress euro‑area growth, with the impact especially pronounced in 2027.

Rees argued that although the ECB’s statement and forecasts lean hawkish, the threshold for another hike remains high, and this move looks more like the last hike of the current cycle rather than the start of a prolonged tightening period. Unless growth and inflation accelerate markedly again, markets should not assume rates will march toward 3%.

Quilter Cheviot fixed‑income research head Richard Carter said the ECB’s balancing act is becoming increasingly tricky. Growth remains fragile in parts of the euro area, and policymakers must weigh curbing inflation against avoiding further damage to the economy. Stagnating inflation has not yet become a baseline scenario, but the combination of weakening growth and rekindling inflation pressures is becoming harder to ignore.

Aviva Investors rates head Ed Hutchings said the ECB’s immediate priority is indeed to rein in inflation, so market expectations of further hikes are not unfounded. However, after two hikes already and market pricing in more than two additional moves, investors’ tightening bets may have gone too far.

Fidelity International euro‑area economist Conor Parle warned that rising natural‑gas and fuel prices will make the ECB watch closely for any spread of price pressures. Recent heatwaves and supply‑chain issues could lift food inflation, and wage‑tracking indicators show a slight acceleration in pay growth, prompting policymakers to watch for early signs that the energy shock is spilling over into other price categories.

items.title: 〈台幣〉買匯力道轉強 貶值4.3分收在31.548元
items.title_en: New Taiwan Dollar Buying Pressure Strengthens, Depreciates 4.3 Cents to Close at 31.548
paras: 新台幣今(10)日升貶互見，午盤過後貶勢擴大，終場收在31.548元，貶值4.3分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值放大至19.39億美元。
新台幣今以31.53元、貶值2.5分開出後，雖一度來到31.49元，但隨後買匯力道轉強，午盤後新台幣越走越低，最低來到31.581元，全日高低價差9.1分。
觀察主要亞幣，韓元貶值近0.2%，新台幣收貶0.14%，泰銖貶近0.1%，日元和星元貶0.05%左右，人民幣平盤附近波動，而美元指數小跌0.05%，市場瀰漫高度觀望聯準會動態的氣氛。
國泰證期研究部指出，台灣 8 月出口年增 41%，金額創單月新高，AI 需求支撐半導體與伺服器營收展望，惟傳產復甦不均，成本壓力仍須關注，大額貿易順差則有利支撐台幣匯率。
統一投顧則分析，台股基本面支撐力道極強，8 月AI 伺服器供應鏈 8 月營收全數締造新猷，展現強韌獲利動能，緊接著輝達管理層出席高盛科技大會，有望釋出下一階段 AI 需求的樂觀展望，惟地緣政治與油價、債市風暴未歇，短線盤面難免受到牽制。
paras_en: The New Taiwan dollar showed mixed movement today (the 10th), with depreciation expanding after the midday session and closing at 31.548, a loss of 4.3 cents. Taipei foreign‑exchange brokerage firms saw transaction volume rise to US$1.939 billion.

The NTD opened at 31.53, down 2.5 cents, briefly fell to 31.49, but buying pressure soon strengthened. After the midday session the currency kept sliding, reaching a low of 31.581, with a total intraday range of 9.1 cents.

Among the major Asian currencies, the Korean won weakened by about 0.2%, the NTD fell 0.14%, the Thai baht slipped nearly 0.1%, the Japanese yen and Singapore dollar each lost roughly 0.05%, the Chinese yuan hovered near flat, and the U.S. dollar index slipped 0.05% as markets remained highly cautious about Federal Reserve moves.

Citi Securities’ research team noted that Taiwan’s August exports grew 41% year‑on‑year, hitting a record monthly total. AI demand underpins a positive outlook for semiconductor and server revenues, though recovery in traditional industries is uneven and cost pressures remain a concern. A large trade surplus, however, supports the NTD’s exchange rate.

Unified Investment Advisory analyzed that Taiwan’s equity fundamentals are very strong, with AI‑related server supply‑chain revenues in August all hitting new highs, demonstrating robust profit momentum. Following Nvidia’s management appearance at the Goldman Sachs Technology Conference, optimism about the next phase of AI demand is expected. Nevertheless, geopolitical tensions, oil price volatility, and turmoil in the bond market persist, keeping short‑term market moves constrained.

items.title: 貝森特自稱莊家 對日元與美股意味著什麼？
items.title_en: Biden Claims to Be the House: What It Means for the Yen and US Stocks
paras: 美國財長貝森特向來直言不諱，但他周二晚間在南方衛理公會大學商學院發表的談話，可能是其從政以來態度最強硬的一次。
貝森特談到的，不只是美國財政部近期為支撐日元所採取的干預行動，也包括美方在阿根廷上次大選前，為穩定披索所做的努力。
曾任總體經濟交易員的貝森特表示：「每當有人說，『財長這是在冒險』，我要說，這正是我夢寐以求的局面。我掌握不對稱資訊，現在莊家是我。」
他接著說：「因此，當我們出手干預日元時，我非常清楚日本政府、日本央行及日本決策官員接下來會怎麼做。你想跟我對賭，儘管來。」
到目前為止，美方的外匯干預已取得成效；相較之下，財政部宣布將買進長天期美債後，殖利率僅短暫回落。貝森特介入債市的做法，也遭到其恩師、知名投資人德魯肯米勒（Stanley Druckenmiller）批評。
美日聯手干預前，美元兌日元一度逼近164，目前已回落至約153，最新跌幅約0.32%。
高盛分析師普里沃羅茨基（Rich Privorotsky）在報告中指出，貝森特這番談話帶來的次級效應，才是影響股市的關鍵。市場擔心，隨著日元升值，原本借入低利率日元、再投入其他資產的投資人，將不得不縮減甚至完全平倉，亦即所謂的日元套利交易可能加速退場。
普里沃羅茨基表示：「當以日元融資的套利交易解除，資金回流日本債券與股票時，市場會發生什麼事？」他指出，標普500指數和大型科技股近期在缺乏明顯基本面利空的情況下，走勢卻異常沉重。值得留意的是，部分槓桿與套利部位可能正逐步從市場消退。
瑞銀全球財富管理首席經濟學家唐納文（Paul Donovan）則表示：「只有當日元貶值是由投機因素造成時，賭場的比喻才成立。如果干預前的日元匯價是由基本面驅動，那麼更貼切、儘管較少人熟悉的比喻，應是英國1992年的匯率機制危機。在這種情況下，貝森特應該宣稱：『我就是拉蒙特。』」
拉蒙特（Norman Lamont）當時擔任英國財政大臣，曾試圖讓英國留在歐洲匯率機制內，但最終未能成功。
paras_en: US Treasury Secretary Biden is known for speaking bluntly, but his remarks on Tuesday night at the Business School of Southern Methodist University may be the toughest stance he’s taken in his political career.
Biden discussed not only the Treasury’s recent intervention to support the yen, but also US efforts to stabilize the peso before Argentina’s last election.

Former macro trader Biden said, "Whenever someone says, 'The Treasury is taking a risk,' I reply that this is exactly the scenario I’ve dreamed of. I have asymmetric information, and now I am the house."
He added, "So when we intervene in the yen, I know exactly what the Japanese government, the Bank of Japan and Japanese policymakers will do next. If you want to bet against me, go ahead."

So far the US foreign‑exchange intervention has shown results; by contrast, after the Treasury announced it would buy long‑term US bonds, yields only fell briefly. Biden’s move into the bond market was also criticized by his mentor, famed investor Stanley Druckenmiller.
Before the US‑Japan joint intervention, the dollar‑yen rate briefly approached 164, now it has slipped to about 153, a recent decline of roughly 0.32%.

Goldman Sachs analyst Rich Privorotsky noted in a report that the secondary effects of Biden’s comments are the real driver for equities. The market worries that a stronger yen will force investors who borrowed cheap yen to fund other assets to unwind or fully close those positions, accelerating the exit of yen‑carry trades.

Privorotsky said, "When yen‑funded arbitrage unwinds and capital flows back into Japanese bonds and stocks, what will happen to the market?" He pointed out that the S&P 500 and large‑cap tech stocks have been unusually heavy despite a lack of clear fundamental downside, and that some leveraged and arbitrage positions may be gradually disappearing from the market.

UBS Global Wealth Management chief economist Paul Donovan said, "The casino analogy only holds if yen depreciation is driven by speculation. If the pre‑intervention yen rate was fundamentally driven, a more apt, though less familiar, comparison is the 1992 UK exchange‑rate mechanism crisis. In that case, Biden should claim: 'I am Lamont.'"
Norman Lamont was the UK Chancellor at the time who tried to keep Britain in the European Exchange Rate Mechanism but ultimately failed.

items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Shows Minor Fluctuations, Market Focuses on Central Bank Meetings
paras: 美元周三(9日)變動不大，市場焦點持續落在近期大幅走強的日元。外匯市場參與者正為關鍵的時刻做準備，歐洲央行(ECB)本周將公布利率決議，聯準會(Fed)與日本銀行(BoJ)將於下周公布決策。
美國公債市場同樣受關注，財政部公布備受期待的公債回購操作更新後，規模令投資人失望。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.1%，報98.83。
美國財政部宣布將回購60億美元、到期年限10年至20年的美國公債，高於先前的20億美元，消息公布後市場拋售美債，美國公債殖利率大幅上升。
美國財政部上月曾表示，將把公債回購規模提高至至少40億美元，但媒體報導此前市場預期規模至少會達到100億美元。
美國10年期公債殖利率上升3.5個基點至4.839%。在財政部公布消息前，殖利率僅上升1.2個基點至4.816%。對利率更加敏感的美國2年期公債殖利率則上升2.7個基點至4.425%。
財政部的回購行動原本被視為一項意外的干預措施，目的是限制美國公債殖利率持續飆升的走勢，而美債近期一直遭遇大規模拋售。
此次美債拋售受到多重因素推動，包括油價飆升引發的通膨疑慮、企業為支應人工智慧基礎建設而大舉發債所帶來的市場擔憂，以及對美國國債規模持續膨脹的疑慮。
布魯金斯研究院經濟研究資深研究員Robin Brooks表示，「試圖透過公債回購等方式，人為壓低長期殖利率的問題在於，如果市場認為回購規模太小，殖利率反而會跳升。這顯示市場底層的上行壓力非常強勁。」
目前市場正密切等待周四公布的8月生產者物價指數(PPI)及周五公布的消費者物價指數(CPI)，以尋找進一步的利率線索。如果通膨數據高於預期，可能使市場對聯準會下周升息的預期明顯升溫。
日元持續徘徊逾七個月高點
日元已成為主要貨幣中表現最亮眼貨幣，光是9月以來就上漲4%。本月初開始的強勁漲勢，周二一度推動日元升至152.89兌1美元的高點。周三日元延續升勢，美元兌日元下跌0.2%，至153.63。
日元受到日本銀行政策收緊預期及市場廣泛猜測日本政府可能再次干預匯市等因素支撐。金融市場幾乎已確定日本銀行將於9月18日升息25個基點，交易員也認為，日本銀行總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)可能暗示年底前還會進一步推動貨幣政策正常化。
LPL Financial技術策略師Adam Turnquist周二表示，「日元的漲勢反映出基本面與技術面真正發生轉變，日銀正進一步走向政策正常化，同時突破原有趨勢。投資人應密切關注152這個關鍵價位，若日元明確突破該支撐並進一步升值，可能加速日元漲勢、迫使更多空頭回補，並重新引發日元套利交易平倉的風險，進而對包括美國公債在內的全球資產產生連鎖影響。」
本周稍早公布的官方數據顯示，日本8月外國證券持有量創紀錄減少878億美元。外匯存底的大幅下降，直接為東京規模達15兆日元(976.7億美元)的匯市干預行動提供資金，其中部分行動是與美國同步進行。
其他貨幣方面，歐元兌美元上漲0.1%，至1.1629美元。
歐洲央行幾乎已被市場一致預期，周四將升息25個基點。
德意志銀行Jim Reid表示，「市場確實可以討論，在供給衝擊之下，歐洲央行是否應該繼續升息……但市場顯然認為，央行的政策反應函數與能源價格高度相關，近期油價與天然氣價格上漲，使市場對最終利率的定價達到3%。」
他補充，「因此，明天升息基本上已經確定，但接下來的情況就會變得更加複雜。如果能源價格維持在目前水準，經濟成長應該會受到影響，但到目前為止，實際影響遠沒有市場原先預期的那麼大，因此歐洲央行面臨的高度不確定性必須受到重視。」

paras_en: The dollar changed little on Wednesday (the 9th), with market attention still on the yen, which has surged sharply in recent weeks. Forex participants are preparing for a pivotal moment as the European Central Bank (ECB) will announce its rate decision this week, and the Federal Reserve (Fed) and Bank of Japan (BoJ) will release their decisions next week.
The U.S. Treasury market is also in focus; after the Treasury released an eagerly awaited update on its bond repurchase operations, the size disappointed investors.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, rose 0.1% to 98.83.

The U.S. Treasury announced a repurchase of $6 billion of Treasury bonds with maturities of 10 to 20 years, higher than the previously announced $2 billion. After the news, the market sold off Treasuries, and Treasury yields jumped sharply.
Last month the Treasury said it would raise the repurchase size to at least $4 billion, but media reports noted that the market had previously expected the size to be at least $10 billion.

The 10‑year Treasury yield rose 3.5 basis points to 4.839%. Before the Treasury’s announcement, the yield had risen only 1.2 basis points to 4.816%. The more rate‑sensitive 2‑year Treasury yield climbed 2.7 basis points to 4.425%.
The repurchase action was originally seen as an unexpected intervention aimed at curbing the continued surge in Treasury yields, as Treasuries have recently faced large‑scale selling.

The recent Treasury sell‑off was driven by multiple factors, including inflation worries sparked by soaring oil prices, market concerns over corporations issuing massive debt to fund AI infrastructure, and doubts about the ever‑expanding size of U.S. government debt.

Robin Brooks, senior economist at the Brookings Institution, said, "The problem with trying to artificially lower long‑term yields through repurchases is that if the market thinks the repurchase size is too small, yields can actually jump. This shows that the underlying upward pressure in the market is very strong."

The market is now closely awaiting Thursday’s August Producer Price Index (PPI) and Friday’s Consumer Price Index (CPI) for further rate clues. If inflation data comes in hotter than expected, expectations for a Fed rate hike next week could rise sharply.
The yen continues to hover near a seven‑month high.

The yen has become the best‑performing major currency, up 4% since September. A strong rally that began early this month pushed the yen to a high of 152.89 per dollar on Tuesday. On Wednesday the yen kept climbing, with USD/JPY down 0.2% to 153.63.

The yen is being supported by expectations of tighter Bank of Japan policy and widespread speculation that the Japanese government may intervene in the FX market again. The financial markets are almost certain that the BoJ will raise rates by 25 basis points on September 18, and traders also think BoJ Governor Kazuo Ueda may hint at further policy normalization before year‑end.

Adam Turnquist, technology strategist at LPL Financial, said on Tuesday, "The yen’s rally reflects a real shift in fundamentals and technicals, with the BoJ moving further toward policy normalization and breaking its previous trend. Investors should watch the key level of 152 closely; if the yen decisively breaks that support and appreciates further, it could accelerate the rally, force more short covering, and reignite the risk of yen‑carry‑trade unwind, which could have cascading effects on global assets, including U.S. Treasuries."

Official data released earlier this week showed that Japan’s August foreign‑securities holdings fell by a record $87.8 billion. The sharp drop in foreign‑exchange reserves directly funds Tokyo’s ¥15 trillion (about $97.67 billion) FX‑intervention capacity, some of which is coordinated with the United States.
Among other currencies, the euro rose 0.1% against the dollar to $1.1629.
The ECB is almost unanimously expected by the market to raise rates by 25 basis points on Thursday.

Jim Reid of Deutsche Bank said, "The market can indeed discuss whether, under a supply shock, the ECB should keep raising rates… but the market clearly sees the ECB’s policy response function as highly linked to energy prices. Recent spikes in oil and gas have pushed market pricing of the final rate to about 3%."

He added, "Therefore, a rate hike tomorrow is basically a given, but what follows will become more complex. If energy prices stay at current levels, economic growth should be affected, but so far the real impact has been far less than markets originally expected, so the high uncertainty facing the ECB must be taken seriously."

items.title: 日元強勢反攻！日本升息恐掀套利交易平倉 美股、AI科技股小心了
items.title_en: Yen’s Strong Rebound! Japan Rate Hike Could Trigger Arbitrage Unwinding, Watch US Stocks and AI Tech Shares
paras: 日元近期大幅升值，兌美元價位從160一路升破153，然而策略師警告，若日元繼續走強並造成「套利交易」快速平倉，可能引發股市拋售，而高估值的美國科技股將首當其衝。
多年來，華爾街交易員熱愛能「輕鬆賺錢」的「日元套利交易」：以近乎零利率的成本在日本借錢，再把資金投入其他市場追逐更高報酬，主要流向美股市場。
但這項押注如今面臨瓦解風險，近期日元兌美元大幅升值，加上市場普遍預期日本銀行(BOJ, 央行)下周升息，可能重創這項廣受歡迎的交易策略。
日元周二(8日)延續兌美元升勢，盤中一度升破153，最高報152.89日元兌1美元，創2月以來最強。
市場預期日銀下周將大幅升息，成為推動日元上漲的主要動力。市場也開始揣測，日本當局可能再次低調干預外匯市場，以抑制日元近期跌勢。
日元兌美元上周已跌破160整數關卡。160通常被視為關鍵門檻，日元一旦升至這一水準，日本政府干預匯市的可能性將提高。根據FactSet數據，日元兌美元9月迄今已升值近4%。
在此背景下，市場動能可能讓股市投資人暴露在一項意料之外的衝擊中：日元持續升值，進而引發套利交易快速平倉。
所謂套利交易，是指投資人以較低利率借入資金，再投入可能帶來較高報酬的資產。日元套利交易則是借入低收益的日元，買進收益率較高的美元，再將美元投入美國資產，例如科技股。
舉例來說，1年期日本政府公債殖利率約1.55%，1年期美國國庫券殖利率約4.12%，兩者相差約2.57個百分點。換句話說，日元套利交易可藉由這項利差提高投資報酬。
但這項交易也可能以同樣強大的力量反向運作。如果日元突然進一步升值，就像近幾天的走勢一樣，投資人可能被迫迅速解除套利部位。這意味著投資人可能必須賣出以美元計價的資產，再將資金換回日元，以償還以日元計價的借款。
市場不久前就曾承受這種痛楚。2024年夏季日元大幅升值，引發股市震盪，套利交易平倉尤其威脅當時漲勢凌厲的美國科技股。
如今外匯市場可能再次具備類似條件。市場預期日銀將升息，而單是升息預期本身就可能進一步推升日元。
Swissquote資深分析師Ipek Ozkardeskaya表示，這類套利交易平倉「可能對AI／科技股族群造成尤其嚴重的衝擊」，因為高估值與部位過度集中，可能放大潛在的拋售壓力。
她指出，這將為逢低買進創造機會，因為套利交易平倉不會永遠持續，但短期內——可能持續數周，投資人將感受到壓力。
不過，Clocktower Group首席市場策略師Eric Wallerstein認為，這一次日元套利交易出現系統性平倉的可能性不高，因為交易員大多已經預期日元今年還會進一步升值。因此，日元若再突然升值，較不容易讓交易員措手不及，這或許足以避免出現恐慌性的大規模平倉。
Wallerstein表示，只要日本利率仍遠低於全球其他地區，「套利交易就仍會存在」。但若要重演幾年前出現的劇烈震盪，日元必須出現「幅度大且出乎意料」的升值。
2024年夏季套利交易平倉期間，日元兌美元在短短兩個月內升值13%。相比之下，這一次自7月底美元兌日元匯率觸及高點以來，美元兌日元匯率貶值不到6%。
paras_en: The yen has surged sharply lately, climbing from around 160 per dollar to break below 153, but strategists warn that if the yen keeps strengthening and forces a rapid unwind of “arbitrage trades,” it could spark a stock‑market sell‑off, with over‑valued US tech stocks hit first.

For years Wall Street traders have loved the easy‑money “yen arbitrage” play: borrow at near‑zero rates in Japan and deploy the funds into other markets for higher returns, mainly flowing into US equities.

That bet now faces collapse risk as the yen has appreciated sharply against the dollar and markets broadly expect the Bank of Japan to raise rates next week, which could cripple this popular strategy.
The yen continued its rise against the dollar on Tuesday the 8th, briefly breaking the 153 level and peaking at ¥152.89 per $1, its strongest since February.

Markets anticipate a sizable BOJ rate hike next week, the main driver behind the yen’s climb, and are also speculating that Japanese authorities may quietly intervene in FX to curb the yen’s recent rally.

Last week the yen fell below the round‑number barrier of 160 per dollar. The 160 level is seen as a key threshold; once the yen reaches it, the likelihood of government FX intervention rises. FactSet data shows the yen has appreciated about 4% against the dollar so far in September.
Against this backdrop, market momentum could expose equity investors to an unexpected shock: a continuously strengthening yen that triggers a rapid unwind of arbitrage positions.

Arbitrage trades involve borrowing at low rates and investing in higher‑yielding assets. Yen arbitrage means borrowing cheap yen, buying higher‑yielding dollars, and deploying those dollars into US assets such as tech stocks.

For example, the 1‑year Japanese government bond yields about 1.55% while the 1‑year US Treasury yields about 4.12%, a spread of roughly 2.57 percentage points, allowing yen arbitrage to boost investment returns.

But the same mechanism can work in reverse. If the yen suddenly appreciates further, as it has in recent days, investors may be forced to unwind arbitrage positions quickly, selling dollar‑denominated assets and converting the proceeds back to yen to repay yen‑denominated loans.
The market felt this pain not long ago. In the summer of 2024 a sharp yen rally rattled equities, and the unwinding of arbitrage trades especially threatened the then‑soaring US tech sector.
Now the FX market may again present similar conditions. Expectations of a BOJ rate hike alone could further lift the yen.
Swissquote senior analyst Ipek Ozkardeskaya said such arbitrage unwinds “could hit AI/tech stocks especially hard” because high valuations and concentrated positions can amplify sell‑pressure.
She added that this could create buying opportunities on dips, since arbitrage unwinds won’t last forever, but in the short term—potentially for several weeks—investors will feel the strain.

However, Clocktower Group chief market strategist Eric Wallerstein believes the chance of a systemic unwind this time is low, as traders largely anticipate further yen gains this year, making a sudden move less likely to catch them off guard and possibly averting panic‑driven mass unwinds.

Wallerstein noted that as long as Japanese rates remain far below those elsewhere, “arbitrage trades will persist.” Yet to repeat the severe volatility seen a few years ago, the yen would need to appreciate “dramatically and unexpectedly.”

During the summer 2024 unwind, the yen rose 13% against the dollar in just two months. By contrast, since the end of July when the USD/JPY peaked, the dollar has depreciated less than 6% against the yen.

items.title: 全球2.34兆美元日元套利交易要變天？日銀升息恐再掀平倉潮
items.title_en: Will the $2.34 trillion Global Yen Arbitrage Trade Turn the Tide? BOJ Rate Hikes Could Spark Another Wave of Unwinding
paras: 日元近期升至7個月高點，市場開始關注，長年支撐全球金融市場的「日元套利交易」是否正走向終點。隨著投資人預期日銀(日本央行/BOJ)最快可能在下周會議加速升息，借入低利日元、轉投資高收益資產的策略正面臨考驗。
所謂套利交易，是借入日元等低利率貨幣，再兌換成美元、墨西哥披索、紐西蘭元或其他新興市場貨幣，投資當地債券或金融工具。交易結束後，投資人再將收益換回日元並償還貸款，賺取兩國利差；若期間日元貶值，還能獲得額外匯兌收益。

美日利差縮小 日元套利吸引力逐漸下降

日元多年來一直是最受歡迎的融資貨幣。美元兌日元套利交易的年率報酬通常約2.5%至3.5%，主要來自美日利差，已低於2024年時的5%至6%。在東京與華盛頓7月底聯手買進日元、干預匯市後，部分套利投資人似乎開始轉向瑞士法郎融資。
現代日元套利交易約在2013年成形。時任日本首相安倍晉三推動量化與質化寬鬆政策，適逢美國利率上升及日元貶值，吸引國際投資人借入日元。2022年至2023年，聯準會(Fed)為抑制通膨快速升息，日銀卻維持負利率，加上日元重貶，套利交易規模進一步膨脹。
由於許多交易透過衍生性商品、避險基金及高槓桿操作，市場無法掌握確切規模。不過，Jefferies分析國際清算銀行(BIS)資料發現，截至今年3月，跨境日元借款已攀升至創紀錄的360兆日元，約2.34兆美元，為近30年最大一波套利交易累積。
美國商品期貨交易委員會(CFTC)數據則顯示，截至9月1日當周，日元淨空單增至92,227口，連續第3周上升，但仍低於7月1日當周創下的兩年高點163,412口。考量基金普遍使用槓桿，實際曝險可能遠高於期貨數據呈現的規模。

2024年曾掀全球股災 這次市場已有準備

若日元突然大幅升值，投資人便須買回日元償還借款，並拋售原先持有的股票、債券與高收益貨幣，可能形成連鎖賣壓。2024年7月，日銀意外升息至當時15年高點，日元數日內從約154日元兌1美元急升至141日元，迫使套利交易迅速平倉，全球股市隨之重挫，日經225指數更曾單日暴跌12.4%。
不過，目前尚無跡象顯示類似衝擊正在重演。日銀官員近幾周已持續暗示升息將至，未來可能還需要進一步收緊政策，市場因此有時間調整部位。日元這波升值走勢也相對有序，股市至今大致消化升息訊號。
這意味日元套利交易可能逐步退潮，而非像2024年般突然瓦解。然而，面對規模龐大且高度槓桿化的部位，只要日銀升息幅度超出預期或日元漲勢突然加速，全球市場仍可能再度承受平倉衝擊。
paras_en: The yen has recently risen to a seven‑month high, prompting markets to wonder whether the long‑standing "yen arbitrage trade" that underpins global finance is nearing its end. With investors expecting the Bank of Japan (BOJ) could accelerate rate hikes as early as next week’s meeting, the strategy of borrowing cheap yen to chase higher‑yielding assets is coming under pressure.

Arbitrage trades involve borrowing yen or other low‑interest currencies, converting them into dollars, Mexican pesos, New Zealand dollars or other emerging‑market currencies, and investing in local bonds or financial instruments. After the trade is closed, investors convert the returns back into yen to repay the loan, pocketing the interest‑rate differential; if the yen depreciates during the holding period, they also capture extra foreign‑exchange gains.

The yen’s appeal as a financing currency is waning as the US‑JPY spread narrows. For years the yen has been the most popular funding currency. Annual returns on USD/JPY arbitrage typically range from about 2.5% to 3.5%, driven mainly by the US‑Japan rate gap, down from 5%‑6% in 2024. After Tokyo and Washington jointly bought yen and intervened in the currency market at the end of July, some arbitrageurs appear to be shifting toward Swiss‑franc financing.

Modern yen arbitrage took shape around 2013. Then‑Prime Minister Shinzo Abe pushed quantitative and qualitative easing while US rates were rising and the yen was weakening, attracting international investors to borrow yen. From 2022 to 2023 the Fed hiked aggressively to curb inflation while the BOJ kept rates negative and the yen kept falling, causing the arbitrage market to swell further.

Because many trades are executed through derivatives, hedge funds and high‑leverage structures, the exact size of the market is hard to gauge. However, Jefferies’ analysis of BIS data shows that by March this year cross‑border yen borrowing had surged to a record 360 trillion yen – about $2.34 trillion – the largest accumulation of arbitrage activity in the past 30 years.

CFTC data indicate that for the week ending September 1, net short positions on yen futures rose to 92,227 contracts, marking a third consecutive week of increase, though still below the two‑year peak of 163,412 contracts set in the week of July 1. Given that funds typically use leverage, the actual exposure may be far higher than the futures numbers suggest.

If the yen were to appreciate sharply, investors would have to buy yen to repay loans and sell the stocks, bonds and high‑yield currencies they hold, potentially triggering a cascade of selling pressure. In July 2024 the BOJ unexpectedly raised rates to a 15‑year high, sending the yen from roughly ¥154 per dollar to ¥141 within days, forcing a rapid unwind of arbitrage positions and sending global equities tumbling, with the Nikkei 225 plunging 12.4% in a single day.

So far there are no signs that a similar shock is replaying. BOJ officials have been hinting in recent weeks that further rate hikes are imminent and that policy may need to tighten further, giving markets time to adjust positions. The yen’s recent appreciation has been relatively orderly, and equity markets have largely digested the rate‑hike signal.

This suggests that yen arbitrage may recede gradually rather than collapse abruptly as in 2024. Nevertheless, given the massive and highly leveraged exposure, any BOJ rate‑hike larger than expected or a sudden acceleration in yen gains could still deliver another round of forced liquidations to global markets.

items.title: 34年前「金融偷獵者」 大獲全勝 貝森特改換角色當莊家
items.title_en: 34 Years Ago the ‘Financial Predator’ Won Big, Bessent Switches Role to Become the House
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)本周展現出極具戰術性的貨幣政策風格，公開向外匯交易員喊話，大膽宣告「我現在就是莊家」。他強調自己對日本央行與日本政策制定者的行動擁有「資訊不對稱」優勢，並直接挑戰市場交易員敢不敢與他作對。
這種將主導權掌握在手的強硬作風，深深植根於他34年前協助索羅斯「擊潰英格蘭銀行」的頂尖避險基金經歷。
據《Fortune》記者Eva Roytburg報導，1992年時年僅29歲的貝森特洞察到英格蘭銀行的致命弱點：央行承諾將英鎊維持在歐洲匯率機制(ERM)的狹幅區間內，但透過升息來保衛匯率的做法，會嚴重打擊當時持有浮動利率房貸的英國屋主。
貝森特成功說服老闆索羅斯對英鎊發動大規模做空，最終迫使英國退出ERM，並為基金賺進10億美元利潤。Roytburg總結，貝森特從中汲取的關鍵教訓是：「當央行人為將貨幣維持在市場無法支持的水準時，市場最終將會獲勝」。
34年後，貝森特角色互換，從昔日的「金融偷獵者」變成了坐鎮局面的「金融護林員」。據報導，貝森特目前正與日本當局協調購買日元，且他多次暗示希望東京當局調升利率，而非僅依賴反覆干預。在他的警告與干預下，美元兌日元匯率已從2026年7月的163上方，一路回落至9月8日的153.96。
然而，這套強硬手法也在內部引發質疑；昔日索羅斯時期的同僚Stanley Druckenmiller公開指責他介入債券市場是個錯誤，而貝森特則反駁稱，擴大買回舊美債旨在冷卻美國公債市場的「發燒」現象。
據《路透》報導，日本央行預計在即將召開的會議上提高基準利率，這成為驗證貝森特威懾是否有效的即時測試。若日本當局順利升息，貝森特的豪賭就能成立；若日本猶豫不決，這位曾寫下狙擊央行教科書的掌權者，將親自驗證市場規律是否會反噬自己。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent this week displayed a highly tactical monetary‑policy style, publicly telling foreign‑exchange traders, “I am the house now.” He stressed that he has an information‑asymmetry advantage over the Bank of Japan and Japanese policymakers and directly challenged market participants to see if they dare to go against him.
This hard‑line approach of keeping control in his own hands is deeply rooted in his experience 34 years ago when he helped George Soros’s top hedge fund “crush the Bank of England.”

According to Fortune reporter Eva Roytburg, in 1992 the then‑29‑year‑old Bessent spotted a fatal weakness in the Bank of England: the central bank’s commitment to keep the pound within the narrow band of the European Exchange Rate Mechanism (ERM, then called the “snake”) would, if defended by raising rates, severely hurt British homeowners with variable‑rate mortgages.

Bessent successfully persuaded his boss Soros to launch a massive short on the pound, ultimately forcing the UK out of the ERM and earning the fund a $1 billion profit. Roytburg summed up Bessent’s key lesson: “When a central bank artificially holds a currency at a level the market cannot support, the market will eventually win.”

Thirty‑four years later Bessent has swapped roles, turning from a “financial predator” into a “financial forest‑ranger” who sits at the table. Reports say he is now coordinating with Japanese authorities to buy yen and has repeatedly hinted that he wants Tokyo to raise rates rather than rely solely on repeated interventions. Under his warnings and actions the USD/JPY rate has fallen from above 163 in July 2026 to 153.96 on September 8.

However, this hard‑line play has sparked internal criticism; Stanley Druckenmiller, a former colleague from the Soros era, publicly said Bessent’s foray into the bond market was a mistake, while Bessent retorted that expanding purchases of old U.S. Treasuries is meant to cool the “fever” in the U.S. government‑bond market.

Reuters reports that the Bank of Japan is expected to raise its policy rate at the upcoming meeting, providing an immediate test of whether Bessent’s deterrence works. If Japanese authorities hike rates, Bessent’s big gamble pays off; if they hesitate, the man who once wrote the textbook on targeting central banks will see market forces turn against him.
